guide.summary: Chinese cannot put a number or 这/那/哪/每/几 straight onto a noun: a measure word goes in between, and the noun decides which one (三本书, 这件衣服, 哪家饭馆). Think of it as 'three volumes of book'. Learn each noun with its measure, use 个 only where no special one exists, and remember the two exceptions: 一些/一点儿 take no extra measure, and 天/年 are already measures themselves.

subs.label: A measure is required
subs.focus: Is a measure needed, and where? Number/这/那/哪/每/几 + measure + noun; with a number too: 这三本书. Errors: dropping it English-style (三书, 这书, 每学生) or misplacing it (三这本书). Use nouns whose measure is obvious so only presence and position are tested; ∅ options and judge items fit.

subs.label: Objects by shape: 本 张 条 件 把 支 棵 朵 封 片 块
subs.focus: Choose by shape or type in a full sentence: 本 volumes, 张 flat, 条 long and bendy (also trousers, skirts, roads), 件 tops and matters, 把 handles, 支 pens, 棵 trees, 朵 flowers, 封 letters, 片 slices, 块 chunks. Error: 个 for everything (一个纸) or 张/本, 条/件, 棵/朵 swapped. Distractors must be plainly wrong.

subs.label: Animals, vehicles, machines: 只 头 匹 条 辆 台 部
subs.focus: 只 small animals, birds, one of a pair; 头 cattle and pigs; 匹 horses; 条 fish and snakes; 辆 wheeled vehicles; 台 machines; 部 phones. Errors: 个 or the wrong class (一个马, 一只车, 一辆电脑). Never set 只 against 条 for 狗, or 部 against 台/个 for 手机: both are accepted.

subs.label: People and places: 个 位 口 家 间 座 层
subs.focus: 个 for people; 位 polite for others (老师, 客人), never before bare 人; 口 for family members; 家 businesses; 间 rooms; 座 mountains, bridges, big buildings; 层 floors. Errors: 一位人, 五个口人, 一间公司, 一个山. For 位 against 个 make the politeness obvious (您, 客人, an introduction).

subs.label: Containers, pairs, sets: 杯 瓶 碗 双 套 份 块
subs.focus: The container or group is the measure: 一杯茶, 两瓶水, 一碗饭, 一双鞋, 一套房子, 一份工作, 五块钱. Pick the fitting one and add no 个 or 的 (一个杯咖啡, 一杯的咖啡). 双 only for two separate items (鞋, 袜子, 筷子); 裤子 takes 条, one shoe is 一只鞋. Contrast 一个杯子 with 一杯水.

subs.label: Works, classes, kinds, events: 首 节 门 部 种 场 顿
subs.focus: 首 songs and poems, 节 class periods, 门 courses, 部 films and novels, 种 kinds, 场 matches, shows, rain or snow, 顿 meals. Errors: 个 everywhere, 节/门 swapped, 个 where English says 'kind of'. For 节 against 门 the sentence must show timetable slot or subject. Do not set 部 against 场 for 电影.

subs.label: Counting actions: 次 遍 趟
subs.focus: Counting actions after the verb: 次 occurrences, 遍 start-to-finish passes (read, watch, listen, say, write), 趟 trips there and back. Errors: 遍 or 趟 where nothing is gone through or travelled (去过三遍北京), 个 for times. When 遍 is the answer make 'all the way through' explicit: 次 is often possible too.

subs.label: 一些 and 一点儿 take no other measure
subs.focus: 一些/这些/那些/哪些 and 一点儿 go straight onto the noun. The learner must leave out a second measure (一些本书, 这些个人, 一点儿杯水) and not use 些 with other numbers (三些书). Also 这些 for several things against 这 + measure for one. ∅ options and judge items fit.

subs.label: 两天, 三年 but 两个月, 两个星期, 两个小时
subs.focus: Does the time word take 个? 天 and 年 never (两天, 三年, 每天, 几年); 月 always when counting months (两个月, 每个月). Errors: 两个天, 三个年, 每个天, 三月 for 'three months' (it means March). For 星期 and 小时 make 个 the answer and offer no ∅ distractor: 两星期 and 两小时 are also said.

rules.rule: A number, 这, 那, 哪, 每 or 几 never touches a noun directly: the noun's measure word goes in between. If there is also a number, it goes between the pointing word and the measure.
rules.pattern: Number / 这 / 那 / 哪 / 每 / 几 + (Number) + Measure + Noun

rules.note: In fast casual speech people do say 这书 or 那人, but in standard and written Chinese keep the measure: 这本书, 那个人.

rules.rule: Pick the measure from shape or type: 本 bound books, 张 flat things (paper, tickets, tables, beds), 条 long bendy things (trousers, skirts, roads, rivers), 件 tops and matters, 把 things you grip, 支 pens.
rules.pattern: Number + 本 / 张 / 条 / 件 / 把 / 支 + Noun

examples.zh: 外面下雨了，带一把伞吧。
examples.py: wài miàn xià yǔ le dài yī bǎ sǎn ba

rules.note: 个 is the fallback only for nouns with no special measure (人, 问题, 苹果, 包). With a noun that has its own measure, 个 sounds wrong or childish.

rules.rule: 棵 counts trees and plants, 朵 flowers, 封 letters and emails, 片 thin slices and tablets, 块 solid chunks or pieces.
rules.pattern: Number + 棵 / 朵 / 封 / 片 / 块 + Noun

examples.py: tā sòng le wǒ yī duǒ huā

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le yī fēng xìn
examples.en: I received a letter yesterday.

examples.py: zhè kuài dàn gāo zhēn hǎo chī
examples.en: This piece of cake is really tasty.

rules.note: 一块蛋糕 is one piece; 一个蛋糕 is a whole cake. Both are correct, with different meanings.

rules.rule: 只 for small animals and birds, 头 for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses, 条 for fish; 辆 for anything on wheels, 台 for machines, 部 for phones.
rules.pattern: Number + 只 / 头 / 匹 / 条 / 辆 / 台 / 部 + Noun

examples.py: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī māo

examples.py: nà pǐ mǎ pǎo de hěn kuài

examples.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu liǎng tái diàn nǎo
examples.en: There are two computers in the office.

rules.note: Usage varies for some nouns: a dog is 一只狗 or 一条狗, a phone is 一部手机, 一个手机 or 一台手机. 只 also counts one of a pair: 一只手, 一只鞋.

rules.rule: People take 个. Use 位 to be polite about someone else, before a title or role, never before bare 人. Count the members of a family with 口.
rules.pattern: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 / 哪 + 个 / 位 / 口 + Person noun

examples.py: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè jiě jie

examples.py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén
examples.en: There are five people in my family.

rules.note: 位 honours the other person, so in careful speech you do not use it about yourself (我们三个人), although answering 三位 to a waiter's 几位 is common.

rules.rule: 家 counts businesses (shops, restaurants, companies, banks), 间 rooms, 座 big fixed things (mountains, bridges, tall buildings, cities), 层 floors.
rules.pattern: Number / 这 / 那 + 家 / 间 / 座 / 层 + Place noun

rules.note: Some place nouns accept more than one measure: 一家医院 or 一所医院, 一间教室 or 一个教室.

rules.rule: A container or grouping word is itself the measure: no 个 before it and no 的 after it. 双 is for things that come as two separate items, 套 for sets and flats, 份 for portions, copies and jobs, 块 for money in speech.
rules.pattern: Number + 杯 / 瓶 / 碗 / 双 / 套 / 份 / 块 + Noun

rules.note: When the container is the thing being counted it is an ordinary noun with 个: 一个杯子, 两个瓶子, 一个碗. English 'a pair of trousers' is not 双: 一条裤子.

rules.rule: 场 counts events that run their course (matches, shows, a fall of rain or snow); 顿 counts meals.

rules.rule: To count how often, put number + 次 after the verb. Use 遍 when the whole thing is gone through from start to finish, and 趟 for a trip there and back.
rules.pattern: Verb + 了 / 过 + Number + 次 / 遍 / 趟

rules.note: 次 is the general word and is often possible where 遍 is used (再说一次 is also said); 遍 adds 'all the way through'. 遍 and 趟 are wrong where there is no content to go through or no journey.

rules.rule: 一些, 这些, 那些, 哪些 and 一点儿 attach straight to the noun. Never add another measure, and never use 些 with a number other than 一.

rules.note: 个 can be dropped before 星期 and 小时 in speech (两星期, 两小时) but never before 月: 三月 means March, not three months. 分钟, 岁 and 周 take no 个 either.

right.py: wǒ mǎi le sān běn shū

contrasts.why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun; 书 needs its measure 本 in between.

right.py: zhè běn shū shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de

contrasts.why: English 'this book' has no measure, but standard Chinese puts one after 这 and 那. 这书 is only heard in casual speech.

right.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ
right.en: Please give me a sheet of paper.

contrasts.why: 个 is not a universal measure. Paper is flat, so it takes 张.

right.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jiàn chèn shān
right.en: I want to buy two shirts.

contrasts.why: Clothes for the upper body take 件 (trousers and skirts take 条), not 个.

right.py: wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi
right.en: I'd like a cup of coffee.

contrasts.why: 杯 is already the measure here, so 个 has no place. 个 appears only when you count the cups themselves: 一个杯子.

right.py: wài miàn yǒu yī gè rén zhǎo nǐ
right.en: There is someone outside looking for you.

contrasts.why: 位 is polite but does not go with bare 人. Say 一个人, or use 位 with a role word such as 客人 or 老师.

right.py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shū

contrasts.why: 些 fills the measure slot itself, so 一些 goes straight onto the noun with no second measure.

right.py: wǒ zài zhōng guó zhù le liǎng nián
right.en: I lived in China for two years.

contrasts.why: 年 and 天 are measures themselves, so they never take 个.

right.py: wǒ xué le sān gè yuè hàn yǔ
right.en: I studied Chinese for three months.

contrasts.why: 月 is a noun and needs 个 when you count months. Without 个, 三月 is the month of March.

right.py: wǒ qù guò sān cì shàng hǎi
right.en: I have been to Shanghai three times.

contrasts.why: 遍 counts going through something from start to finish, such as a book or a film. Visits are simply occurrences, so 次.

cheat: Number, 这, 那, 哪, 每 or 几 before a noun? A measure goes in between: 三本书, 这本书.
Look at the noun, not the English: flat 张, long 条, bound 本, tops 件, handle 把, wheels 辆, machine 台, business 家.
个 only when the noun has no measure of its own, and never together with another measure (一杯咖啡, not 一个杯咖啡).
一些, 这些, 那些, 一点儿: straight onto the noun, nothing added.
两天, 三年, 每天 with no 个; 两个月, 两个星期, 两个小时 with 个.
Polite about someone else: 位, with a role word and never with bare 人.
How many times: 次. All the way through: 遍. There and back: 趟.

items.q: 她在办公室给自己泡了一___热茶。
items.zh: 她在办公室给自己泡了一杯热茶。
items.py: tā zài bàn gōng shì gěi zì jǐ pào le yī bēi rè chá
items.en: She made herself a cup of hot tea in the office.
items.why: The cup is the measure for a drink: 一杯茶, with no 个. 双 is for pairs and 套 for sets.

items.q: 这___饭馆的面条很便宜，我们常去那儿吃午饭。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的面条很便宜，我们常去那儿吃午饭。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de miàn tiáo hěn pián yi wǒ men cháng qù nà r chī wǔ fàn
items.en: The noodles at this restaurant are cheap; we often have lunch there.
items.why: A restaurant is a business, and businesses take 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed structures, 层 for floors.

items.s: 我每个星期有两节汉语课，每个月还要考一次试。
items.s_py: wǒ měi gè xīng qī yǒu liǎng jié hàn yǔ kè měi gè yuè hái yào kǎo yī cì shì
items.zh: 我每个星期有两节汉语课，每个月还要考一次试。
items.py: wǒ měi gè xīng qī yǒu liǎng jié hàn yǔ kè měi gè yuè hái yào kǎo yī cì shì
items.en: I have two Chinese classes every week and a test every month.
items.why: 星期 and 月 take 个 after 每, while 节 counts class periods and 次 counts tests, so every measure here is right.

items.s: 我买了一个蛋糕给同事过生日，大家都很开心。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi le yí gè dàn gāo gěi tóng shì guò shēng rì dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn
items.zh: 我买了一个蛋糕给同事过生日，大家都很开心。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yí gè dàn gāo gěi tóng shì guò shēng rì dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn
items.en: I bought a cake for a colleague's birthday and everyone was happy.
items.why: A whole cake is 一个蛋糕; 块 would count a piece of it. 个 is correct here.

items.zh: 我学了三个月汉语。
items.py: wǒ xué le sān gè yuè hàn yǔ
items.en: I studied Chinese for three months.
items.why: Duration goes after the verb: 三个月. 月 needs 个 when counting months.

items.s: 那几本书都是我从学校借来的。
items.s_py: nà jǐ běn shū dōu shì wǒ cóng xué xiào jiè lái de
items.zh: 那几本书都是我从学校借来的。
items.py: nà jǐ běn shū dōu shì wǒ cóng xué xiào jiè lái de
items.en: Those few books were all borrowed from the school by me.
items.why: 几 can stand in the number slot after 那: 那 + 几 + 本 + 书 is correct. It looks unusual but follows the normal order.

items.q: 学校组织我们去农场参观，那里养了二十___牛。
items.zh: 学校组织我们去农场参观，那里养了二十头牛。
items.py: xué xiào zǔ zhī wǒ men qù nóng chǎng cān guān nà lǐ yǎng le èr shí tóu niú
items.en: The school took us to visit a farm where they keep twenty cows.
items.why: Cattle take 头. 只 is for small animals, 匹 for horses and 条 for fish.

items.s: 老师让我们每个人唱一首中文歌。
items.s_py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi gè rén chàng yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
items.zh: 老师让我们每个人唱一首中文歌。
items.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi gè rén chàng yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
items.en: The teacher asked each of us to sing a Chinese song.
items.why: Songs take 首, and 每个人 is correct because 个 follows 每 before 人.

items.s: 我昨天把三这份文件都交给了经理。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ sān zhè fèn wén jiàn dōu jiāo gěi le jīng lǐ
items.zh: 我昨天把这三份文件都交给了经理。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zhè sān fèn wén jiàn dōu jiāo gěi le jīng lǐ
items.en: Yesterday I handed all three of these documents to the manager.
items.why: The pointing word comes before the number: 这三份文件. 三这份 reverses it, which is impossible.

items.q: 我昨天在学校的书店买了三___书。
items.zh: 我昨天在学校的书店买了三本书。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài xué xiào de shū diàn mǎi le sān běn shū
items.en: I bought three books at the school bookstore yesterday.
items.why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun, so 三书 is wrong. Books are bound volumes and take 本; 条 is for long bendy things.

items.q: 他在河边钓了三___大鱼，第二天带到公司给同事们看。
items.zh: 他在河边钓了三条大鱼，第二天带到公司给同事们看。
items.py: tā zài hé biān diào le sān tiáo dà yú dì èr tiān dài dào gōng sī gěi tóng shì men kàn
items.en: He caught three big fish by the river and took them to the office the next day to show his colleagues.
items.why: Fish take 条. 只 is for small land animals and birds, 头 for cattle, 匹 for horses.

items.q: 我们班每___学生都有一本词典。
items.zh: 我们班每个学生都有一本词典。
items.py: wǒ men bān měi gè xué shēng dōu yǒu yī běn cí diǎn
items.en: Every student in our class has a dictionary.
items.why: 每 must be followed by a measure word, and 学生 takes 个. 每学生 drops it the English way; 些 and 本 do not fit people.

items.q: 教室外面站着一___学生，他们都在等着见老师。
items.zh: 教室外面站着一些学生，他们都在等着见老师。
items.py: jiào shì wài miàn zhàn zhe yī xiē xué shēng tā men dōu zài děng zhe jiàn lǎo shī
items.en: A few students are standing outside the classroom, and they are all waiting to see the teacher.
items.why: The students are plural (他们), so it is 一些学生. 一个 would mean just one student; 一点儿 is only for things that cannot be counted.

items.zh: 这家饭馆的菜很好吃。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài hěn hǎo chī
items.en: The food at this restaurant is delicious.
items.why: 这 + 家 + noun forms the phrase, then 的 links it to 菜. 家 must follow 这 and precede 饭馆.

items.q: 我家有四___人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
items.zh: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén ： bà bà 、 mā mā 、 gē gē hé wǒ
items.en: There are four people in my family: Dad, Mum, my brother and me.
items.why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 间 is for rooms, 座 for bridges and mountains, 层 for floors.

items.q: 她用两个星期读完了那___长篇小说。
items.zh: 她用两个星期读完了那部长篇小说。
items.py: tā yòng liǎng gè xīng qī dú wán le nà bù cháng piān xiǎo shuō
items.en: She finished that long novel in two weeks.
items.why: A novel takes 部. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 场 for events.

items.q: 我们公司在十___，你坐电梯上来吧。
items.zh: 我们公司在十层，你坐电梯上来吧。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī zài shí céng nǐ zuò diàn tī shàng lái ba
items.en: Our company is on the tenth floor, so take the lift up.
items.why: Floors of a building take 层. 间 counts rooms, 家 counts businesses, 座 counts whole buildings.

items.q: 她在晚会上唱了一___中文歌。
items.zh: 她在晚会上唱了一首中文歌。
items.py: tā zài wǎn huì shàng chàng le yī shǒu zhōng wén gē
items.en: She sang a Chinese song at the party.
items.why: Songs and poems take 首. 部 is for films and novels, 节 for classes and 场 for events.

items.zh: 他每天睡八个小时。
items.py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He sleeps eight hours every day.
items.why: 每天 takes no 个, but 八个小时 does. The time word may come before or after the subject, and the duration stays after the verb.

items.q: 这___水果我没吃过，叫什么名字？
items.zh: 这种水果我没吃过，叫什么名字？
items.py: zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ wǒ méi chī guò jiào shén me míng zì
items.en: I have never eaten this kind of fruit; what is it called?
items.why: Kinds of things are counted with 种. 首, 部 and 场 count songs, films and events.

items.q: ___三本书都是老师借给我的。
items.zh: 这三本书都是老师借给我的。
items.py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì lǎo shī jiè gěi wǒ de
items.en: These three books were all lent to me by the teacher.
items.why: The order is pointing word + number + measure + noun. 这个 or 那些 cannot be stacked in front of 三本; only a bare 这 fits before the number.

items.q: 这___课有四个学分，所以我们不能不及格。
items.zh: 这门课有四个学分，所以我们不能不及格。
items.py: zhè mén kè yǒu sì gè xué fēn suǒ yǐ wǒ men bù néng bù jí gé
items.en: This course carries four credits, so we cannot afford to fail.
items.why: Credits belong to a course as a subject, which is counted with 门. 节 would mean a single class period.

items.q: 她在银行找到了一___很不错的工作。
items.zh: 她在银行找到了一份很不错的工作。
items.py: tā zài yín háng zhǎo dào le yī fèn hěn bú cuò de gōng zuò
items.en: She found a pretty good job at a bank.
items.why: A job is counted with 份. 家 is for the company itself, not the post, and 座 and 本 do not fit work.

items.q: 医生让我每天吃两___药，吃完饭以后再吃。
items.zh: 医生让我每天吃两片药，吃完饭以后再吃。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī liǎng piàn yào chī wán fàn yǐ hòu zài chī
items.en: The doctor told me to take two tablets a day, after meals.
items.why: Thin tablets are counted with 片. 块 is for solid chunks, 张 for large flat things and 朵 for flowers.

items.q: 公司晚上请客户吃了一___饭。
items.zh: 公司晚上请客户吃了一顿饭。
items.py: gōng sī wǎn shàng qǐng kè hù chī le yī dùn fàn
items.en: The company took the client out for a meal in the evening.
items.why: A meal is counted with 顿. 场 is for events like matches and rain, 节 and 门 for classes.

items.q: 桌子上放着三___笔。
items.zh: 桌子上放着三支笔。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe sān zhī bǐ
items.en: There are three pens on the desk.
items.why: Pens take 支. 把 is for things with a handle, 条 for long bendy things and 张 for flat sheets.

items.q: 我们的公司在上海有两___分公司，在北京还有一家。
items.zh: 我们的公司在上海有两家分公司，在北京还有一家。
items.py: wǒ men de gōng sī zài shàng hǎi yǒu liǎng jiā fēn gōng sī zài běi jīng hái yǒu yī jiā
items.en: Our company has two branches in Shanghai and one more in Beijing.
items.why: Companies and branches are businesses and take 家. 间 counts rooms, 座 counts buildings, 层 counts floors.

items.q: 关于这___事，我们明天开会再讨论。
items.zh: 关于这件事，我们明天开会再讨论。
items.py: guān yú zhè jiàn shì wǒ men míng tiān kāi huì zài tǎo lùn
items.en: As for this matter, we will discuss it at tomorrow's meeting.
items.why: 件 counts matters and affairs as well as tops. 条 would only fit a road or a rule, 张 and 把 do not fit 事.

items.s: 我去过三遍上海。
items.s_py: wǒ qù guò sān biàn shàng hǎi
items.zh: 我去过三次上海。
items.py: wǒ qù guò sān cì shàng hǎi
items.en: I have been to Shanghai three times.
items.why: 遍 means going through something from start to finish. Visits to a city are counted with 次.

items.q: 他在北京学了三___年中文。
items.zh: 他在北京学了三年中文。
items.py: tā zài běi jīng xué le sān nián zhōng wén
items.en: He studied Chinese in Beijing for three years.
items.why: 年 is a measure word on its own: 三年, with no 个. 三个年 is wrong.

items.q: 我请了三___天假，下星期一回来上班，请大家别担心。
items.zh: 我请了三天假，下星期一回来上班，请大家别担心。
items.py: wǒ qǐng le sān tiān jià xià xīng qī yī huí lái shàng bān qǐng dà jiā bié dān xīn
items.en: I have taken three days of leave and will be back at work next Monday, so please don't worry.
items.why: 天 is itself a measure word, so 三天假 takes no 个. 三个天 is wrong.

items.q: 今天上午我们有四___课，从八点上到十二点。
items.zh: 今天上午我们有四节课，从八点上到十二点。
items.py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ wǒ men yǒu sì jié kè cóng bā diǎn shàng dào shí èr diǎn
items.en: We have four classes this morning, from eight to twelve.
items.why: Class periods on the timetable take 节; running from eight to twelve fills four periods. 门 would mean four different subjects.

items.q: 这些___书都是图书馆的，不能带回家。
items.zh: 这些书都是图书馆的，不能带回家。
items.py: zhè xiē shū dōu shì tú shū guǎn de bù néng dài huí jiā
items.en: These books all belong to the library and cannot be taken home.
items.why: 这些 already fills the measure position, so the noun follows directly: 这些书.

items.s: 我家有三口人，住在学校附近。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
items.zh: 我家有三口人，住在学校附近。
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
items.en: There are three of us in my family and we live near the school.
items.why: 口 is the measure for family members, so 三口人 is correct, though learners expect 个.

items.s: 我在这家公司工作了两个年。
items.s_py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le liǎng gè nián
items.zh: 我在这家公司工作了两年。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le liǎng nián
items.en: I have worked at this company for two years.
items.why: 年 is a measure itself, so it takes no 个: 两年.

items.q: 我们的暑假只有两___月，不太长。
items.zh: 我们的暑假只有两个月，不太长。
items.py: wǒ men de shǔ jià zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè yuè bù tài cháng
items.en: Our summer holiday is only two months, not very long.
items.why: Counting months needs 个: 两个月. Without it 两月 would read as 'February'.

items.s: 桌上有一个杯子，旁边还有一杯热茶。
items.s_py: zhuō shàng yǒu yí gè bēi zi lǐ miàn yǒu yī bēi rè chá
items.zh: 桌上有一个杯子，旁边还有一杯热茶。
items.py: zhuō shàng yǒu yí gè bēi zi páng biān hái yǒu yī bēi rè chá
items.en: There is a cup on the table, and next to it a cup of hot tea.
items.why: The cup as an object takes 个 (一个杯子), while the tea is counted with 杯 (一杯热茶). Both are correct.

items.q: 我第一___见到李老师是在大学开学那天。
items.zh: 我第一次见到李老师是在大学开学那天。
items.py: wǒ dì yī cì jiàn dào lǐ lǎo shī shì zài dà xué kāi xué nà tiān
items.en: The first time I saw Teacher Li was on the first day of university.
items.why: 第一次 is the fixed way to say 'the first time'. 遍 and 趟 would need a text or a trip.

items.q: 王总，我给您介绍一下，这___是我们部门的新经理。
items.zh: 王总，我给您介绍一下，这位是我们部门的新经理。
items.py: wáng zǒng wǒ gěi nín jiè shào yī xià zhè wèi shì wǒ men bù mén de xīn jīng lǐ
items.en: Mr Wang, let me introduce you: this is our department's new manager.
items.why: Introducing a person respectfully to 您 calls for polite 位. 口, 家 and 间 are for family members, businesses and rooms.

items.q: 老师给我们看了一张照片，上面有一___马在河边吃草。
items.zh: 老师给我们看了一张照片，上面有一匹马在河边吃草。
items.py: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men kàn le yī zhāng zhào piān shàng miàn yǒu yì pǐ mǎ zài hé biān chī cǎo
items.en: The teacher showed us a photo of a horse eating grass by the river.
items.why: Horses take 匹. 头 is for cattle and pigs, and 只 or 条 cannot be used for a horse.

items.s: 会议室里坐着五位人。
items.s_py: huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe wǔ wèi rén
items.zh: 会议室里坐着五个人。
items.py: huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe wǔ gè rén
items.en: Five people are sitting in the meeting room.
items.why: 位 is never used with the bare noun 人; say 五个人. 位 needs a role word such as 客人 or 老师.

items.q: 他早饭吃了两___米饭。
items.zh: 他早饭吃了两碗米饭。
items.py: tā zǎo fàn chī le liǎng wǎn mǐ fàn
items.en: He ate two bowls of rice for breakfast.
items.why: Rice is served in a bowl, so 碗. 杯 is for drinks in cups, 瓶 for bottles, 双 for pairs.

items.q: 我有点渴，想喝一点儿___水。
items.zh: 我有点渴，想喝一点儿水。
items.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn kě xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ
items.en: I'm a bit thirsty, I'd like a little water.
items.why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun, so 一点儿水. Adding 杯, 瓶 or 个 after it is wrong.

items.q: 从公司到我家要经过一___很长的桥，所以下雨天特别堵车。
items.zh: 从公司到我家要经过一座很长的桥，所以下雨天特别堵车。
items.py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào jīng guò yī zuò hěn cháng de qiáo suǒ yǐ xià yǔ tiān tè bié dǔ chē
items.en: To get from the company to my home you cross a very long bridge, so traffic is terrible on rainy days.
items.why: Bridges take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses, 层 for floors, and none describes a bridge.

items.q: 学校门口有两___大树，夏天很凉快。
items.zh: 学校门口有两棵大树，夏天很凉快。
items.py: xué xiào mén kǒu yǒu liǎng kē dà shù xià tiān hěn liáng kuài
items.en: There are two big trees at the school gate; it's cool there in summer.
items.why: Trees and plants take 棵. 朵 is for flowers and 片 for slices or open areas, so neither fits a tree.

items.q: 上个月公司招了一些___新同事，办公室一下子热闹起来。
items.zh: 上个月公司招了一些新同事，办公室一下子热闹起来。
items.py: shàng gè yuè gōng sī zhāo le yī xiē xīn tóng shì bàn gōng shì yī xià zi rè nào qǐ lái
items.en: The company hired some new colleagues last month and the office suddenly became lively.
items.why: 一些 fills the measure slot, so no 位, 个 or 名 follows. 一些位同事 is wrong.

items.q: 你们班有几___学生？
items.zh: 你们班有几个学生？
items.py: nǐ men bān yǒu jǐ gè xué shēng
items.en: How many students are there in your class?
items.why: 几 is a number word, so it needs a measure before the noun. 学生 takes 个; 几学生 without it is not standard and 些 cannot follow 几.

items.q: 老板去上海出差，一个月要跑好几___。
items.zh: 老板去上海出差，一个月要跑好几趟。
items.py: lǎo bǎn qù shàng hǎi chū chāi yí gè yuè yào pǎo hǎo jǐ tàng
items.en: The boss travels to Shanghai on business and makes several trips a month.
items.why: A journey there and back is a 趟. 遍 needs content to run through, and 个 or 层 do not count trips.

items.s: 老板新买了一部手机，还换了一台电脑。
items.s_py: lǎo bǎn xīn mǎi le yī bù shǒu jī hái huàn le yī tái diàn nǎo
items.zh: 老板新买了一部手机，还换了一台电脑。
items.py: lǎo bǎn xīn mǎi le yī bù shǒu jī hái huàn le yī tái diàn nǎo
items.en: The boss bought a new phone and also replaced his computer.
items.why: Phones take 部 and computers take 台, so both are right even though they look alike.

items.q: 昨天我们看了一___很有意思的电影。
items.zh: 昨天我们看了一部很有意思的电影。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ men kàn le yī bù hěn yǒu yì si de diàn yǐng
items.en: Yesterday we watched a very interesting film.
items.why: A film as a work takes 部. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 门 for courses.

items.q: 请给我一点儿___时间，我马上就好。
items.zh: 请给我一点儿时间，我马上就好。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī diǎn r shí jiān wǒ mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
items.en: Please give me a little time, I'll be ready in a moment.
items.why: 一点儿 takes no further measure, so 一点儿时间. 个, 段 and 份 cannot be added after it.

items.q: 我昨天在学校的书店买了一些___书。
items.zh: 我昨天在学校的书店买了一些书。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài xué xiào de shū diàn mǎi le yī xiē shū
items.en: I bought some books at the school bookstore yesterday.
items.why: 一些 is itself the measure slot, so no other measure may follow it. 一些本书 and 一些个书 are wrong.

items.q: 我同事的猫上个月生了三___小猫，他想送给朋友。
items.zh: 我同事的猫上个月生了三只小猫，他想送给朋友。
items.py: wǒ tóng shì de māo shàng gè yuè shēng le sān zhī xiǎo māo tā xiǎng sòng gěi péng yǒu
items.en: My colleague's cat had three kittens last month, and he wants to give them to friends.
items.why: A cat is a small animal, so 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses and 辆 for vehicles.

items.s: 昨天晚上学校礼堂有一节音乐会，我和同学都去了。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xué xiào lǐ táng yǒu yī jié yīn yuè huì wǒ hé tóng xué dōu qù le
items.zh: 昨天晚上学校礼堂有一场音乐会，我和同学都去了。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xué xiào lǐ táng yǒu yī chǎng yīn yuè huì wǒ hé tóng xué dōu qù le
items.en: There was a concert in the school hall last night and my classmates and I all went.
items.why: A concert is an event that takes place, counted with 场. 节 is only for class periods.

items.q: 服务员，请再给我一___筷子。
items.zh: 服务员，请再给我一双筷子。
items.py: fú wù yuán qǐng zài gěi wǒ yī shuāng kuài zi
items.en: Waiter, please give me another pair of chopsticks.
items.why: Chopsticks come in twos and take 双. 杯, 碗 and 瓶 are containers.

items.q: 我的运动鞋坏了，得买一___新的。
items.zh: 我的运动鞋坏了，得买一双新的。
items.py: wǒ de yùn dòng xié huài le děi mǎi yī shuāng xīn de
items.en: My trainers are worn out, I have to buy a new pair.
items.why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 件 is for tops and 条 for trousers.

items.q: 我每天睡七___小时，所以白天不困。
items.zh: 我每天睡七个小时，所以白天不困。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí suǒ yǐ bái tiān bù kùn
items.en: I sleep seven hours every day, so I am not sleepy in the daytime.
items.why: 小时 is a noun and takes 个: 七个小时. 些, 次 and 位 do not count hours.

items.zh: 请给我一张纸。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ
items.en: Please give me a sheet of paper.
items.why: Number + measure + noun comes after the verb 给我. The measure 张 stays between 一 and 纸.

items.s: 我们班有二十学生。
items.s_py: wǒ men bān yǒu èr shí xué shēng
items.zh: 我们班有二十个学生。
items.py: wǒ men bān yǒu èr shí gè xué shēng
items.en: There are twenty students in our class.
items.why: A number cannot sit directly on 学生; it needs the measure 个: 二十个学生.

items.q: 这个学期我选了五___课：汉语、数学、历史……
items.zh: 这个学期我选了五门课：汉语、数学、历史……
items.py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le wǔ mén kè ： hàn yǔ 、 shù xué 、 lì shǐ ……
items.en: This term I chose five courses: Chinese, maths, history and so on.
items.why: Courses are counted with 门. The listed subjects show different courses, not class periods, so 节 fails.

items.q: 我去过两___北京，都是出差。
items.zh: 我去过两次北京，都是出差。
items.py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì běi jīng dōu shì chū chāi
items.en: I have been to Beijing twice, both times on business.
items.why: Counting how often something happened takes 次. 遍 needs something gone through from start to finish, and 个 cannot count times.

items.q: 我渴了，去买两___水。
items.zh: 我渴了，去买两瓶水。
items.py: wǒ kě le qù mǎi liǎng píng shuǐ
items.en: I'm thirsty, I'll go and buy two bottles of water.
items.why: Water you buy comes in a bottle: 瓶. 碗 is for food in bowls, 双 for pairs and 套 for sets.

items.q: 公司给每位新同事发了一___文具，里面有笔和本子。
items.zh: 公司给每位新同事发了一套文具，里面有笔和本子。
items.py: gōng sī gěi měi wèi xīn tóng shì fā le yī tào wén jù lǐ miàn yǒu bǐ hé běn zi
items.en: The company gave every new colleague a stationery set with pens and notebooks.
items.why: A set of items belonging together takes 套. 双 needs exactly two, 杯 and 瓶 are containers.

items.zh: 昨天下了一场大雨。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yī cháng dà yǔ
items.en: There was a heavy rain yesterday.
items.why: 场 counts a fall of rain as an event and sits between 一 and 大雨.

items.q: 他新买了一___车，每天开车上班。
items.zh: 他新买了一辆车，每天开车上班。
items.py: tā xīn mǎi le yī liàng chē měi tiān kāi chē shàng bān
items.en: He has bought a new car and drives to work every day.
items.why: Anything on wheels takes 辆. 只, 条 and 匹 count animals.

items.s: 同事们从图书馆借走了一些本书，桌子上只剩两本。
items.s_py: tóng shì men cóng tú shū guǎn jiè zǒu le yī xiē běn shū zhuō zi shàng zhǐ shèng liǎng běn
items.zh: 同事们从图书馆借走了一些书，桌子上只剩两本。
items.py: tóng shì men cóng tú shū guǎn jiè zǒu le yī xiē shū zhuō zi shàng zhǐ shèng liǎng běn
items.en: The colleagues borrowed some books from the library and only two are left on the table.
items.why: 一些 already acts as the measure, so no 本 follows it: 一些书. 本 reappears only with a number, as in 两本.

items.q: 我们打算租一___两室一厅的房子。
items.zh: 我们打算租一套两室一厅的房子。
items.py: wǒ men dǎ suàn zū yī tào liǎng shì yī tīng de fáng zi
items.en: We plan to rent a two-bedroom flat.
items.why: A flat is a set of rooms and takes 套. 双 is for pairs, 杯 for cups and 块 for chunks.

items.q: 我们学校的院子里有两___鸟。
items.zh: 我们学校的院子里有两只鸟。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào de yuàn zi lǐ yǒu liǎng zhǐ niǎo
items.en: There are two birds in our school's yard.
items.why: Small animals and birds take 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses, 条 for fish and snakes.

items.q: 在我看来，每___认真学习的学生都应该得到老师的表扬。
items.zh: 在我看来，每个认真学习的学生都应该得到老师的表扬。
items.py: zài wǒ kàn lái měi gè rèn zhēn xué xí de xué shēng dōu yīng gāi dé dào lǎo shī de biǎo yáng
items.en: In my view, every student who studies seriously deserves the teacher's praise.
items.why: 每 never touches a noun directly, even with a long modifier in between. 学生 takes 个; 每些 is not possible and 条 is for long things.

items.s: 我要一个杯咖啡，不要糖。
items.s_py: wǒ yào yí gè bēi kā fēi bú yào táng
items.zh: 我要一杯咖啡，不要糖。
items.py: wǒ yào yī bēi kā fēi bú yào táng
items.en: I'd like a cup of coffee, no sugar.
items.why: 杯 is already the measure, so 个 must not be added. 个 would only appear with the cup itself: 一个杯子.

items.s: 这篇课文我已经读了三遍，可是还有几个生词不懂。
items.s_py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ yǐ jīng dú le sān biàn kě shì hái yǒu jǐ gè shēng cí bù dǒng
items.zh: 这篇课文我已经读了三遍，可是还有几个生词不懂。
items.py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ yǐ jīng dú le sān biàn kě shì hái yǒu jǐ gè shēng cí bù dǒng
items.en: I have read this text three times already, but there are still a few new words I don't know.
items.why: Reading a text through is counted with 遍. The fronted object 这篇课文 is a normal pattern.

items.s: 我想喝一点儿水，再回去工作。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ zài huí qù gōng zuò
items.zh: 我想喝一点儿水，再回去工作。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng hē yī diǎn r shuǐ zài huí qù gōng zuò
items.en: I'd like a little water and then I'll go back to work.
items.why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun, so 一点儿水 is right with no measure like 杯.

items.zh: 我想买一些新书。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī xiē xīn shū
items.en: I want to buy some new books.
items.why: 一些 sits directly before the adjective and noun, with no other measure added.

items.q: 这___教学楼有六层，教室很多。
items.zh: 这座教学楼有六层，教室很多。
items.py: zhè zuò jiào xué lóu yǒu liù céng jiào shì hěn duō
items.en: This teaching building has six floors and lots of classrooms.
items.why: A building is a big fixed structure and takes 座. 家 is for businesses, 间 for single rooms and 口 for family members.

items.q: 学生们在教室里给李老师送了一___红花，还唱了一首歌。
items.zh: 学生们在教室里给李老师送了一朵红花，还唱了一首歌。
items.py: xué shēng men zài jiào shì lǐ gěi lǐ lǎo shī sòng le yī duǒ hóng huā hái chàng le yī shǒu gē
items.en: In the classroom the students gave Teacher Li a red flower and sang a song.
items.why: A flower takes 朵. 棵 is for whole plants and trees, 片 for slices, 块 for chunks.

items.zh: 办公室里有两台电脑。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu liǎng tái diàn nǎo
items.en: There are two computers in the office.
items.why: Place first, then 有, then number + 台 + noun. The measure 台 sits between 两 and 电脑.

items.s: 我的朋友在这个城市开了一座公司，生意很好。
items.s_py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài zhè ge chéng shì kāi le yī zuò gōng sī shēng yì hěn hǎo
items.zh: 我的朋友在这个城市开了一家公司，生意很好。
items.py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài zhè ge chéng shì kāi le yī jiā gōng sī shēng yì hěn hǎo
items.en: My friend opened a company in this city and business is good.
items.why: A company is a business and takes 家. 座 is for big fixed structures such as buildings and bridges, not for a firm.

items.q: 这个星期我们开了两___会，每次都很长。
items.zh: 这个星期我们开了两次会，每次都很长。
items.py: zhè ge xīng qī wǒ men kāi le liǎng cì huì měi cì dōu hěn cháng
items.en: We had two meetings this week, and each was long.
items.why: Occurrences take 次. A meeting is not read through (遍) or travelled to and fro (趟).

items.zh: 我借了三本书。
items.py: wǒ jiè le sān běn shū
items.en: I borrowed three books.
items.why: Number, then measure, then noun: 三本书. The measure cannot be left out or move behind the noun.

items.s: 办公室门口停着一只车。
items.s_py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī zhī chē
items.zh: 办公室门口停着一辆车。
items.py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng chē
items.en: A car is parked at the office entrance.
items.why: A car runs on wheels and takes 辆. 只 is for small animals.

items.q: 我想订两___房间，住三天。
items.zh: 我想订两间房间，住三天。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng dìng liǎng jiān fáng jiān zhù sān tiān
items.en: I would like to book two rooms for three days.
items.why: Rooms are counted with 间. 家 is for businesses, 层 for floors, 座 for large buildings.

items.q: 他今天穿了一___新裤子去上班。
items.zh: 他今天穿了一条新裤子去上班。
items.py: tā jīn tiān chuān le yī tiáo xīn kù zi qù shàng bān
items.en: He wore a pair of new trousers to work today.
items.why: Trousers are long and bendy, so 条, not 件, which is for tops. 把 and 张 do not describe clothes.

items.q: 老师让我们把这篇课文从头到尾读三___。
items.zh: 老师让我们把这篇课文从头到尾读三遍。
items.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men bǎ zhè piān kè wén cóng tóu dào wěi dú sān biàn
items.en: The teacher asked us to read this text through three times from beginning to end.
items.why: Going through a text from start to finish is 遍. 趟 is for trips, and 个 and 层 do not count actions.

items.q: 对不起，我没听清楚，请您再说一___。
items.zh: 对不起，我没听清楚，请您再说一遍。
items.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ qǐng nín zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that, could you say it once more?
items.why: 遍 counts saying the whole thing through once more. 趟 is for a trip and 个 cannot count an action.

items.q: 下雨了，你带一___伞去学校吧。
items.zh: 下雨了，你带一把伞去学校吧。
items.py: xià yǔ le nǐ dài yī bǎ sǎn qù xué xiào ba
items.en: It's raining, take an umbrella to school.
items.why: An umbrella has a handle, so 把. 件 is for tops, 支 for pens and 条 for long bendy things.

items.q: 你更喜欢哪___词典，红的还是蓝的？
items.zh: 你更喜欢哪本词典，红的还是蓝的？
items.py: nǐ gèng xǐ huān nǎ běn cí diǎn hóng de hái shì lán de
items.en: Which dictionary do you like better, the red one or the blue one?
items.why: 哪 like 这 and 那 needs a measure before the noun, and a dictionary is a bound book: 本. 哪词典 leaves it out; 张 and 把 are for flat and gripped things.

items.q: 我们学校旁边新开了一___银行，办事很方便。
items.zh: 我们学校旁边新开了一家银行，办事很方便。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào páng biān xīn kāi le yī jiā yín háng bàn shì hěn fāng biàn
items.en: A new bank has opened next to our school; it is convenient.
items.why: A bank is a business, so 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed buildings and 层 for floors.

items.q: 我每___天都在图书馆学习。
items.zh: 我每天都在图书馆学习。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
items.en: I study in the library every day.
items.why: 天 is itself a measure, so 每天 takes no 个. 每个天 is wrong.

items.q: 我的书包里有两___词典。
items.zh: 我的书包里有两本词典。
items.py: wǒ de shū bāo lǐ yǒu liǎng běn cí diǎn
items.en: There are two dictionaries in my school bag.
items.why: A dictionary is a bound book, so 本. 张 is for flat sheets and 把 for things with a handle; 条 is for long bendy things.

items.q: 昨天下了一___大雨，我没去学校。
items.zh: 昨天下了一场大雨，我没去学校。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yī cháng dà yǔ wǒ méi qù xué xiào
items.en: There was a heavy rain yesterday, so I did not go to school.
items.why: A fall of rain is an event that runs its course and takes 场. 顿 is for meals and 首 for songs.

items.q: 我今天早上给客户发了一___电子邮件。
items.zh: 我今天早上给客户发了一封电子邮件。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shàng gěi kè hù fā le yī fēng diàn zi yóu jiàn
items.en: This morning I sent a client an email.
items.why: Letters and emails are counted with 封. 张 is for flat sheets and 本 for books.

items.q: 我已经学了六___月汉语了，现在能和同事聊天。
items.zh: 我已经学了六个月汉语了，现在能和同事聊天。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng xué le liù gè yuè hàn yǔ le xiàn zài néng hé tóng shì liáo tiān
items.en: I have studied Chinese for six months now and can chat with colleagues.
items.why: 月 needs 个 when it counts a duration. 六月 without 个 means June, not six months.

items.q: 我想买两___衬衫去面试。
items.zh: 我想买两件衬衫去面试。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jiàn chèn shān qù miàn shì
items.en: I want to buy two shirts to wear to the interview.
items.why: A shirt is a top, and tops take 件. 条 is for trousers and skirts; 张 is for flat sheets.

items.q: 请给我一___纸，我要写字。
items.zh: 请给我一张纸，我要写字。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ wǒ yào xiě zì
items.en: Please give me a sheet of paper, I want to write.
items.why: Paper is flat, so it takes 张. 本 is for bound volumes, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for things you grip.

items.s: 他买了一双新裤子，准备明天上班穿。
items.s_py: tā mǎi le yī shuāng xīn kù zi zhǔn bèi míng tiān shàng bān chuān
items.zh: 他买了一条新裤子，准备明天上班穿。
items.py: tā mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi zhǔn bèi míng tiān shàng bān chuān
items.en: He bought a new pair of trousers to wear to work tomorrow.
items.why: Trousers are long and bendy, so they take 条. English 'a pair of trousers' tempts 双, but 双 is only for things that are two separate items, like shoes.

items.q: 下午两点到两点四十五是第一___课，下课后休息十分钟。
items.zh: 下午两点到两点四十五是第一节课，下课后休息十分钟。
items.py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn dào liǎng diǎn sì shí wǔ shì dì yī jié kè xià kè hòu xiū xī shí fēn zhōng
items.en: The first class runs from two to a quarter to three, and then there is a ten-minute break.
items.why: A slot in the timetable with a start and end time is a period: 节. 门 would name a subject.

items.q: 办公室里有三___电脑，都是新的。
items.zh: 办公室里有三台电脑，都是新的。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu sān tái diàn nǎo dōu shì xīn de
items.en: There are three computers in the office, all new.
items.why: Machines such as computers take 台. 辆 is for vehicles and 只 and 匹 are for animals.

items.q: 经理让我复印三___合同，下午要给客户。
items.zh: 经理让我复印三份合同，下午要给客户。
items.py: jīng lǐ ràng wǒ fù yìn sān fèn hé tóng xià wǔ yào gěi kè hù
items.en: The manager asked me to make three copies of the contract; they go to the client this afternoon.
items.why: Copies of a document are counted with 份. 把 is for things with a handle, 条 for long bendy things and 封 for letters.

items.q: 我想买一___新鞋。
items.zh: 我想买一双新鞋。
items.en: I want to buy a pair of new shoes.
items.why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 条 is for trousers and 件 for tops, and 把 is for things with handles.
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng xīn xié

items.q: 我们家住在五___，没有电梯。
items.zh: 我们家住在五层，没有电梯。
items.en: We live on the fifth floor, and there is no lift.
items.why: Floors of a building are counted with 层. 座 is for a whole building, 间 for rooms and 家 for businesses.
items.py: wǒ men jiā zhù zài wǔ céng méi yǒu diàn tī

items.s: 他每个月都给奶奶寄一点儿钱。
items.zh: 他每个月都给奶奶寄一点儿钱。
items.en: Every month he sends Grandma a little money.
items.why: 月 needs 个 when counted, so 每个月 is right, and 一点儿 goes straight onto 钱.
items.py: tā měi gè yuè dōu gěi nǎi nǎi jì yī diǎn r qián
items.s_py: tā měi gè yuè dōu gěi nǎi nǎi jì yī diǎn r qián

items.s: 妈妈给我买了一个生日蛋糕。
items.zh: 妈妈给我买了一个生日蛋糕。
items.en: Mom bought me a birthday cake.
items.why: A whole cake is counted with 个, while a slice would be 块. This sentence means one whole cake, so it is right.
items.py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè shēng rì dàn gāo
items.s_py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè shēng rì dàn gāo

items.zh: 昨天我陪奶奶去了一趟医院。
items.en: Yesterday I went to the hospital with Grandma.
items.why: The verb is followed by 了, then number and 趟, then the place: 去了一趟医院. Moving 趟 elsewhere breaks the pattern.
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ péi nǎi nǎi qù le yī tàng yī yuàn

items.s: 这三本书都是姐姐送给我的。
items.zh: 这三本书都是姐姐送给我的。
items.en: These three books were all given to me by my older sister.
items.why: The order pointing word, number, measure, noun is exactly right: 这三本书.
items.py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì jiě jiě sòng gěi wǒ de
items.s_py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì jiě jiě sòng gěi wǒ de

items.q: 河边有人钓到了一___大鱼。
items.zh: 河边有人钓到了一条大鱼。
items.en: Someone fishing by the river caught a big fish.
items.why: Fish are long and bendy, so 条. 只 and 头 are for land animals and 匹 is only for horses.
items.py: hé biān yǒu rén diào dào le yī tiáo dà yú

items.s: 我见过他三遍。
items.zh: 我见过他三次。
items.en: I have met him three times.
items.why: Meeting someone is a plain occurrence, not something gone through from start to finish, so 次 is needed.
items.py: wǒ jiàn guò tā sān cì
items.s_py: wǒ jiàn guò tā sān biàn

items.s: 我喜欢三这条裙子。
items.zh: 我喜欢这三条裙子。
items.en: I like these three skirts.
items.why: The pointing word must come before the number, so 这三条, not 三这条.
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhè sān tiáo qún zi
items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huān sān zhè tiáo qún zi

items.q: 桌子上有三___书。
items.zh: 桌子上有三本书。
items.en: There are three books on the table.
items.why: A number cannot sit directly on 书: the measure 本 must come between. 三些书 is impossible, and 张 is for flat things such as paper.
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu sān běn shū

items.q: 我们一家六___人住在一起。
items.zh: 我们一家六口人住在一起。
items.en: Six of us in the family live together.
items.why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 家 counts businesses, 间 rooms and 只 small animals, so none of them fits people.
items.py: wǒ men yī jiā liù kǒu rén zhù zài yī qǐ

items.q: 我们家每___孩子都有一张床。
items.zh: 我们家每个孩子都有一张床。
items.en: Every child in our family has a bed.
items.why: 每 plus a noun needs a measure in between, and for children it is 个. 每孩子 is not standard, and 些 is plural so it cannot follow 每.
items.py: wǒ men jiā měi gè hái zi dōu yǒu yī zhāng chuáng

items.q: 哪些___书是你从图书馆借的，哪些是自己买的？
items.zh: 哪些书是你从图书馆借的，哪些是自己买的？
items.en: Which books did you borrow from the library, and which did you buy yourself?
items.why: 哪些 is already plural and takes no measure. 哪些本书 and 哪些张书 double up the measure.
items.py: nǎ xiē shū shì nǐ cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de nǎ xiē shì zì jǐ mǎi de

items.zh: 我家有五口人。
items.en: There are five people in my family.
items.why: Family members are counted as number + 口 + 人, so 五口人.
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén

items.q: 这___饭馆的菜很便宜。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的菜很便宜。
items.en: The food at this restaurant is cheap.
items.why: A restaurant is a business, so 家. 座 is for big fixed things, 位 for polite people and 口 for family members.
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài hěn pián yi

items.q: 我昨天去了一___超市，买了很多东西。
items.zh: 我昨天去了一趟超市，买了很多东西。
items.en: I made a trip to the supermarket yesterday and bought a lot.
items.why: A trip somewhere and back is 趟. 遍 needs a text or task to go through, and 场 and 顿 do not count trips.
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng chāo shì mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi

items.q: 这套房子有三___卧室。
items.zh: 这套房子有三间卧室。
items.en: This flat has three bedrooms.
items.why: Rooms are counted with 间. 家 is for businesses, 座 for mountains and big buildings, 层 for floors.
items.py: zhè tào fáng zi yǒu sān jiān wò shì

items.q: 周末我们全家一起吃了一___饭。
items.zh: 周末我们全家一起吃了一顿饭。
items.en: At the weekend the whole family had a meal together.

items.q: 妈妈在银行工作，那___银行就在我们家楼下。
items.zh: 妈妈在银行工作，那家银行就在我们家楼下。
items.en: Mom works at a bank, and that bank is right below our flat.
items.why: A bank is a business, so 家. 层 is for floors, 位 for polite people and 口 for family members.

items.en: I ordered Mom a coat online, but the size is a bit big.
items.why: A coat is a top, so 件. 条 is for trousers and skirts, 张 for flat things and 把 for handles.
items.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng gěi mā mā dìng le yī jiàn wài tào kě shì chǐ mǎ yǒu diǎn r dà

items.zh: 爸爸喝了一杯咖啡。

items.s_py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng kù zi

items.q: 桌子上有一___水果，有苹果，也有香蕉。
items.zh: 桌子上有一些水果，有苹果，也有香蕉。
items.en: There is some fruit on the table: apples and bananas.

items.zh: 我想买这本书。
items.en: I want to buy this book.

items.s: 他骑了一只马去山上。

items.en: He rode a horse up the mountain.
items.why: Horses are counted with 匹, never 只.

items.s_py: tā qí le yī zhī mǎ qù shān shàng

items.q: 我早上喝了一___牛奶。
items.zh: 我早上喝了一杯牛奶。
items.en: I drank a glass of milk this morning.
items.why: The container is the measure, so 杯 with no 个. 个牛奶 is wrong, and 条 and 张 are for long or flat things.
items.py: wǒ zǎo shàng hē le yī bēi niú nǎi

items.q: 请给我两___纸，我要写信。
items.zh: 请给我两张纸，我要写信。
items.en: Please give me two sheets of paper; I want to write a letter.
items.why: Paper is flat, so 张. 本 is for bound volumes, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for handles.
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng zhāng zhǐ wǒ yào xiě xìn

items.q: 奶奶生病住院了，妈妈这个星期已经去了三___医院。
items.zh: 奶奶生病住院了，妈妈这个星期已经去了三趟医院。
items.en: Grandma is ill in hospital, and Mom has already gone to the hospital three times this week.
items.why: Going to a place and coming back is 趟. 遍 is for going through something start to finish, and 场 and 顿 do not count trips.
items.py: nǎi nǎi shēng bìng zhù yuàn le mā mā zhè ge xīng qī yǐ jīng qù le sān tàng yī yuàn

items.q: 妈妈买了这___菜，晚上我们做饭。
items.zh: 妈妈买了这些菜，晚上我们做饭。
items.en: Mom bought these vegetables, and we will cook tonight.
items.why: 这些 means 'these' for several things. 这个菜 is one dish, and 条 and 本 do not fit vegetables.
items.py: mā mā mǎi le zhè xiē cài wǎn shàng wǒ men zuò fàn

items.q: 妹妹在院子里摘了一___红花。
items.zh: 妹妹在院子里摘了一朵红花。
items.en: My younger sister picked a red flower in the yard.
items.why: A single flower is counted with 朵. 棵 is for whole trees and plants, 块 for chunks and 条 for long bendy things.
items.py: mèi mèi zài yuàn zi lǐ zhāi le yī duǒ hóng huā

items.q: 书店里有几___书，我们进去看看吧。
items.zh: 书店里有几本书，我们进去看看吧。
items.en: The bookshop has a few books; let's go in and look.
items.why: 几 cannot touch the noun, so the book measure 本 is needed. 几书 and 几些书 are impossible, and 个 is not the measure of 书.
items.py: shū diàn lǐ yǒu jǐ běn shū wǒ men jìn qù kàn kàn ba

items.q: 公园后面有一___小山，周末我们常去那儿玩。
items.zh: 公园后面有一座小山，周末我们常去那儿玩。
items.en: There is a small hill behind the park, and we often play there at weekends.
items.why: A hill or mountain takes 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses and 层 for floors.
items.py: gōng yuán hòu miàn yǒu yī zuò xiǎo shān zhōu mò wǒ men cháng qù nà r wán

items.q: 我学了两___月中文。
items.zh: 我学了两个月中文。
items.en: I studied Chinese for two months.
items.why: To count months you need 个: 两个月. 两月 would read as a calendar month, and 些 clashes with the number.
items.py: wǒ xué le liǎng gè yuè zhōng wén

items.q: 妈妈在书店买了一___字典。
items.zh: 妈妈在书店买了一本字典。
items.en: Mom bought a dictionary at the bookshop.
items.why: A dictionary is a bound volume, so 本. 张 is for flat things, 条 for long bendy things and 把 for things with a handle.
items.py: mā mā zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn zì diǎn

items.zh: 邻居养了一只大狗。
items.en: The neighbour keeps a big dog.
items.why: Number, measure, then noun phrase: 一只大狗. The measure 只 always follows the number directly.

items.q: 昨晚我们去体育馆看了一___篮球比赛，非常精彩。
items.zh: 昨晚我们去体育馆看了一场篮球比赛，非常精彩。
items.en: Last night we went to the stadium to watch a basketball match, and it was brilliant.
items.why: A match is an event that runs its course, so 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 门 for school subjects.
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ men qù tǐ yù guǎn kàn le yī chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài fēi cháng jīng cǎi

items.q: 爸爸给我写了一___长信，说他下个月回家。
items.zh: 爸爸给我写了一封长信，说他下个月回家。
items.en: Dad wrote me a long letter saying he comes home next month.
items.why: Letters are counted with 封. 本 is for books, 片 for thin slices and 块 for chunks.
items.py: bà bà gěi wǒ xiě le yī fēng cháng xìn shuō tā xià gè yuè huí jiā

items.q: 我们搬到这个城市已经十___了，和邻居们都很熟了。
items.zh: 我们搬到这个城市已经十年了，和邻居们都很熟了。
items.en: We have lived in this city for ten years already and are well acquainted with all the neighbours.
items.why: 年 is a measure itself, so 十年. 十个年 adds an extra 个, and 些 and 位 do not fit a number of years.
items.py: wǒ men bān dào zhè ge chéng shì yǐ jīng shí nián le hé lín jū men dōu hěn shú le

items.q: 爸爸穿了一___蓝裤子。
items.zh: 爸爸穿了一条蓝裤子。
items.en: Dad wore a pair of blue trousers.
items.why: Trousers are long and bendy, so 条. 件 is for tops and 张 for flat things; English 'pair' does not make it 双.

items.q: 你要的那四___衣服，我已经帮你放进箱子里了。
items.zh: 你要的那四件衣服，我已经帮你放进箱子里了。
items.en: I have already put the four pieces of clothing you wanted into the suitcase.
items.why: The pattern 那 + number + measure + noun needs 件 for clothes. 那四衣服 skips the measure, 些 clashes with the number four, and 个 is not used for clothes.

items.s: 妈妈给我买了一个新裤子。
items.zh: 妈妈给我买了一条新裤子。
items.en: Mom bought me a new pair of trousers.
items.why: Trousers are long and bendy and take 条. 个 is not used for them.
items.py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi
items.s_py: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè xīn kù zi

items.q: 这本小说我看了两___，每次都有新的感觉。
items.zh: 这本小说我看了两遍，每次都有新的感觉。
items.en: I have read this novel twice and each time felt something new.
items.why: Reading a book from cover to cover is 遍. 趟 is for trips, 场 for events and 顿 for meals.
items.py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn měi cì dōu yǒu xīn de gǎn jué

items.q: 奶奶的农场里有两___牛，还有一___马。
items.zh: 奶奶的农场里有两头牛，还有一匹马。
items.en: Grandma's farm has two cows and also a horse.

items.q: 课间休息十分钟，下一___课是数学。

items.q: 今天很冷，每___学生都穿着厚外套。

items.en: It is cold today and every student is wearing a thick coat.

items.q: 我昨天买了一___厚大衣，下雪的时候穿。
items.zh: 我昨天买了一件厚大衣，下雪的时候穿。

items.q: 医生让我吃这___种药，别的先别吃。

items.q: 春天到了，院子里有两___桃树开花了。
items.zh: 春天到了，院子里有两棵桃树开花了。

items.q: 医生一再提醒，这三___药不能和酒一起吃，不然会很危险。

items.en: The doctor warned again that these three kinds of medicine must not be taken with alcohol.

items.q: 我发烧了，妈妈拿来一___退烧药让我吃。

items.q: 秋天到了，地上落了一___黄叶。
items.zh: 秋天到了，地上落了一片黄叶。

items.en: The nurse brought a thermometer and asked me to take my temperature.
items.why: A thermometer is a slim stick-like instrument counted with 支. 把 is for things you grip, 本 for books, 条 for long bendy things.

items.q: 他一直在咳嗽，我给他递了一___纸巾。
items.zh: 他一直在咳嗽，我给他递了一张纸巾。

items.en: He kept coughing, so I handed him a tissue.

items.q: 暴雨过后，小路上倒了一___大树，车都过不去。
items.zh: 暴雨过后，小路上倒了一棵大树，车都过不去。

items.q: 夏天太热了，我家新买了一___空调。
items.zh: 夏天太热了，我家新买了一台空调。

items.en: It is so hot in summer that we bought a new air conditioner.

items.q: 雪地里有一___小鸟在找东西吃。
items.zh: 雪地里有一只小鸟在找东西吃。

items.en: There is a little bird in the snow looking for something to eat.

items.q: 下大雨了，路上的车很少，只有一___公共汽车慢慢开过来。
items.zh: 下大雨了，路上的车很少，只有一辆公共汽车慢慢开过来。

items.en: It was pouring and there were few cars; only one bus came slowly along.

items.q: 台风快来了，农场里的那两___牛都被带进了棚里。
items.zh: 台风快来了，农场里的那两头牛都被带进了棚里。

items.why: Cattle take 头. 匹 is for horses, 条 for fish, and 只 is for small animals and birds.

items.q: 医院新买了一___大机器，可以给病人检查身体。
items.zh: 医院新买了一台大机器，可以给病人检查身体。
items.py: yī yuàn xīn mǎi le yī tái dà jī qì kě yǐ gěi bìng rén jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
items.en: The hospital bought a big new machine that can examine patients.
