items.q: 农场的人说，下暴雨以前，那几___猪一直不肯吃东西。
items.zh: 农场的人说，下暴雨以前，那几头猪一直不肯吃东西。
items.py: nóng chǎng de rén shuō xià bào yǔ yǐ qián nà jǐ tóu zhū yì zhí bù kěn chī dōng xi
items.en: The farmer said that before the downpour those few pigs refused to eat.
items.why: Pigs are counted with 头, like cattle. 匹 is only for horses, 辆 for wheeled vehicles, and 条 for fish and snakes.

items.q: 这___药店离我家很近，我感冒的时候常去。
items.zh: 这家药店离我家很近，我感冒的时候常去。
items.py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn wǒ gǎn mào de shí hou cháng qù
items.en: This pharmacy is close to my home and I often go there when I have a cold.
items.why: A pharmacy is a business, so 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed structures, 层 for floors.

items.q: 我们住的房间在二十___，窗外可以看到下雪。
items.zh: 我们住的房间在二十层，窗外可以看到下雪。
items.py: wǒ men zhù de fáng jiān zài èr shí céng chuāng wài kě yǐ kàn dào xià xuě
items.en: Our room is on the twentieth floor and you can see snow outside the window.
items.why: Floors of a building are counted with 层. 间 counts the room itself, 座 a whole building and 家 a business.

items.q: 我们家有四___人，冬天常常一起吃火锅。
items.zh: 我们家有四口人，冬天常常一起吃火锅。
items.py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén dōng tiān cháng cháng yì qǐ chī huǒ guō
items.en: There are four people in my family and in winter we often have hot pot together.
items.why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 间 is for rooms, 层 for floors and 座 for big structures.

items.q: 下大雨以后，那___桥被水冲坏了，我们只好走另一条路。
items.zh: 下大雨以后，那座桥被水冲坏了，我们只好走另一条路。
items.py: xià dà yǔ yǐ hòu nà zuò qiáo bèi shuǐ chōng huài le wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zǒu lìng yī tiáo lù
items.en: After the heavy rain that bridge was washed out so we had to take another road.
items.why: Bridges are big fixed structures counted with 座. 家 is for businesses, 层 for floors and 口 for family members.

items.q: 医院的这___病房很安静，朝南，下午有阳光。
items.zh: 医院的这间病房很安静，朝南，下午有阳光。
items.py: yī yuàn de zhè jiān bìng fáng hěn ān jìng cháo nán xià wǔ yǒu yáng guāng
items.en: This hospital ward is quiet, faces south and gets sun in the afternoon.
items.why: A room takes 间. 家 counts businesses, 座 big structures and 口 family members.

items.q: 那___山冬天常常下雪，山顶上一年四季都是白的。
items.zh: 那座山冬天常常下雪，山顶上一年四季都是白的。
items.py: nà zuò shān dōng tiān cháng cháng xià xuě shān dǐng shàng yī nián sì jì dōu shì bái de
items.en: That mountain often has snow in winter and its top is white all year round.
items.why: Mountains take 座. 层 is for floors, 家 for businesses and 口 for family members.

items.q: 我家住在六___，没有电梯，生病的时候上楼很难。
items.zh: 我家住在六层，没有电梯，生病的时候上楼很难。
items.py: wǒ jiā zhù zài liù céng méi yǒu diàn tī shēng bìng de shí hou shàng lóu hěn nán
items.en: We live on the sixth floor with no lift, so it is hard to climb the stairs when I am ill.
items.why: Floors are counted with 层. 间 is a room, 座 is a whole building or mountain and 家 is a business.

items.q: 这座城市夏天又热又潮，所以市中心新开了好几___卖空调和风扇的商店。
items.zh: 这座城市夏天又热又潮，所以市中心新开了好几家卖空调和风扇的商店。
items.py: zhè zuò chéng shì xià tiān yòu rè yòu cháo suǒ yǐ shì zhōng xīn xīn kāi le hǎo jǐ jiā mài kōng tiáo hé fēng shàn de shāng diàn
items.en: The summers in this city are hot and damp, so several shops selling air conditioners and fans have opened downtown.
items.why: Shops are businesses, counted with 家. 口 is for family members, 座 for big fixed structures and 层 for floors.

items.q: 夏天的时候，我们一家四___人经常开车去海边度假。
items.zh: 夏天的时候，我们一家四口人经常开车去海边度假。
items.py: xià tiān de shí hou wǒ men yī jiā sì kǒu rén jīng cháng kāi chē qù hǎi biān dù jià
items.en: In summer the four of us often drive to the seaside for a holiday.
items.why: Family members are counted with 口: 一家四口人. 位 is polite for others and cannot be used about one's own family here.

items.q: 感冒了，多喝几___热水就会好一点儿。
items.zh: 感冒了，多喝几杯热水就会好一点儿。
items.py: gǎn mào le duō hē jǐ bēi rè shuǐ jiù huì hǎo yì diǎn r
items.en: If you have a cold, drink a few cups of hot water and you'll feel better.
items.why: A cup is the measure for a drink: 几杯热水. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets, 份 for portions.

items.q: 天太热了，我一口气喝了两___冰水。
items.zh: 天太热了，我一口气喝了两瓶冰水。
items.py: tiān tài rè le wǒ yì kǒu qì hē le liǎng píng bīng shuǐ
items.en: It was so hot that I drank two bottles of iced water in one go.
items.why: Bottled water is counted by the bottle: 瓶. 双 is for pairs, 份 for portions and 套 for sets.

items.q: 我生病的时候，妈妈给我煮了一___热粥。
items.zh: 我生病的时候，妈妈给我煮了一碗热粥。
items.py: wǒ shēng bìng de shí hou mā ma gěi wǒ zhǔ le yī wǎn rè zhōu
items.en: When I was ill, Mum cooked me a bowl of hot porridge.
items.why: Porridge is eaten from a bowl and counted by it: 碗. 把 is for things with handles, 套 for sets, 双 for pairs.

items.q: 冬天路滑，爸爸给我买了一___防滑的鞋。
items.zh: 冬天路滑，爸爸给我买了一双防滑的鞋。
items.py: dōng tiān lù huá bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng fáng huá de xié
items.en: The roads are slippery in winter, so Dad bought me a pair of non-slip shoes.
items.why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 件 is for tops, 条 for trousers and 套 for sets.

items.q: 医生说我可以吃东西了，我点了一___清淡的午饭。
items.zh: 医生说我可以吃东西了，我点了一份清淡的午饭。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chī dōng xi le wǒ diǎn le yī fèn qīng dàn de wǔ fàn
items.en: The doctor said I could eat again, so I ordered a light lunch.
items.why: A portion of food ordered in a restaurant is a 份. 双 is for pairs, 瓶 for bottles and 套 for sets.

items.q: 天冷了，奶奶给我织了一___厚手套。
items.zh: 天冷了，奶奶给我织了一双厚手套。
items.py: tiān lěng le nǎi nai gěi wǒ zhī le yī shuāng hòu shǒu tào
items.en: It has got cold, so Grandma knitted me a pair of thick gloves.
items.why: Gloves come as a pair, so 双. 条 is for long things, 套 for sets and 件 for tops.

items.q: 夏天容易出汗，我每天都要多喝几___水。
items.zh: 夏天容易出汗，我每天都要多喝几杯水。
items.py: xià tiān róng yì chū hàn wǒ měi tiān dōu yào duō hē jǐ bēi shuǐ
items.en: I sweat easily in summer, so I have to drink a few more cups of water every day.
items.why: 杯 is already the measure, so no 个 is added (个杯) and no 的 follows it (杯的水).

items.q: 医生建议我换一___更安静的房子，这样晚上才能睡好。
items.zh: 医生建议我换一套更安静的房子，这样晚上才能睡好。
items.py: yī shēng jiàn yì wǒ huàn yī tào gèng ān jìng de fáng zi zhè yàng wǎn shàng cái néng shuì hǎo
items.en: The doctor advised me to move to a quieter flat so that I can sleep well at night.
items.why: A flat is counted as a set of rooms with 套. 双 is for pairs, 份 for portions and 瓶 for bottles.

items.q: 夏天太热，他一连吃了三___西瓜，结果肚子疼了。
items.zh: 夏天太热，他一连吃了三块西瓜，结果肚子疼了。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè tā yī lián chī le sān kuài xī guā jié guǒ dǔ zi téng le
items.en: It was so hot that he ate three pieces of watermelon in a row and ended up with a stomach ache.
items.why: A piece cut from a melon is a chunk, 块. 杯 is for drinks, 双 for pairs and 套 for sets.

items.q: 她因为身体不好，辞掉了原来那___工作。
items.zh: 她因为身体不好，辞掉了原来那份工作。
items.py: tā yīn wèi shēn tǐ bù hǎo cí diào le yuán lái nà fèn gōng zuò
items.en: Because of her poor health she gave up her former job.
items.why: A job is counted with 份. 套 is for sets, 双 for pairs and 杯 for cups.

items.q: 昨天下了一___大雪，路上到处都是白的。
items.zh: 昨天下了一场大雪，路上到处都是白的。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng dà xuě lù shàng dào chù dōu shì bái de
items.en: It snowed heavily yesterday and the roads are white everywhere.
items.why: A fall of snow that runs its course is counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 门 for courses.

items.q: 我今天上午有两___课，下午去医院。
items.zh: 我今天上午有两节课，下午去医院。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ yǒu liǎng jié kè xià wǔ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I have two classes this morning and go to the hospital in the afternoon.
items.why: Class periods on a timetable are counted with 节. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 场 for events.

items.q: 我感冒好了，今天想吃一___好吃的。
items.zh: 我感冒好了，今天想吃一顿好吃的。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào hǎo le jīn tiān xiǎng chī yī dùn hǎo chī de
items.en: My cold has gone and today I want to have a nice meal.
items.why: A meal is counted with 顿. 场 is for matches and rain, 首 for songs, 门 for courses.

items.q: 这个学期我选了一___关于健康的课，老师是位医生。
items.zh: 这个学期我选了一门关于健康的课，老师是位医生。
items.py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le yī mén guān yú jiàn kāng de kè lǎo shī shì wèi yī shēng
items.en: This term I chose a course on health, and the teacher is a doctor.
items.why: Choosing a subject for a term is a course, 门. 节 would be one period on the timetable, which you cannot choose.

items.q: 下午第二___是体育课，下雨的话就在室内上。
items.zh: 下午第二节是体育课，下雨的话就在室内上。
items.py: xià wǔ dì èr jié shì tǐ yù kè xià yǔ de huà jiù zài shì nèi shàng
items.en: The second period this afternoon is PE, and if it rains it will be held indoors.
items.why: Ordinal slots of the school day are 节: 第二节. 门 counts different subjects, not periods.

items.q: 夏天的晚上，公园里有一___露天音乐会，很多人去听。
items.zh: 夏天的晚上，公园里有一场露天音乐会，很多人去听。
items.py: xià tiān de wǎn shàng gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī chǎng lù tiān yīn yuè huì hěn duō rén qù tīng
items.en: On summer evenings there is an open-air concert in the park and many people go.
items.why: A concert is an event that runs its course: 场. 首 would count single songs.

items.q: 她唱了一___关于春天的歌，大家都鼓掌了。
items.zh: 她唱了一首关于春天的歌，大家都鼓掌了。
items.py: tā chàng le yī shǒu guān yú chūn tiān de gē dà jiā dōu gǔ zhǎng le
items.en: She sang a song about spring and everyone applauded.
items.why: Songs are counted with 首. 场 is for events, 部 for films and 门 for courses.

items.q: 这___感冒在冬天特别常见，不一定要吃药。
items.zh: 这种感冒在冬天特别常见，不一定要吃药。
items.py: zhè zhǒng gǎn mào zài dōng tiān tè bié cháng jiàn bù yí dìng yào chī yào
items.en: This kind of cold is very common in winter and doesn't always need medicine.
items.why: 'This kind of' is 这种. 门, 场 and 首 count courses, events and songs, not types.

items.q: 因为下大雨，那___足球比赛被取消了。
items.zh: 因为下大雨，那场足球比赛被取消了。
items.py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ nà chǎng zú qiú bǐ sài bèi qǔ xiāo le
items.en: Because of the heavy rain, that football match was cancelled.
items.why: A match is an event counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 部 for films and 门 for courses.

items.q: 一___春雨过后，山上的树都变绿了。
items.zh: 一场春雨过后，山上的树都变绿了。
items.py: yī chǎng chūn yǔ guò hòu shān shàng de shù dōu biàn lǜ le
items.en: After one spring rain the trees on the hills all turned green.
items.why: A fall of rain is counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 部 for films or novels.

items.q: 为了不感冒，你应该好好吃每一___饭，不要饿着肚子去上班。
items.zh: 为了不感冒，你应该好好吃每一顿饭，不要饿着肚子去上班。
items.py: wèi le bù gǎn mào nǐ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo chī měi yī dùn fàn bú yào è zhe dǔ zi qù shàng bān
items.en: To avoid catching a cold, you should eat every meal properly and not go to work hungry.
items.why: Meals are counted with 顿: 每一顿饭. 场 is for events, 首 for songs and 门 for courses.

items.q: 医生让我每天吃三___药，饭后吃。
items.zh: 医生让我每天吃三次药，饭后吃。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān cì yào fàn hòu chī
items.en: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day after meals.
items.why: Occasions of an action are counted with 次. 趟 is for trips, 场 for events, and 个 is not a measure for times.

items.q: 我昨天去了一___医院，医生说我没事。
items.zh: 我昨天去了一趟医院，医生说我没事。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng yī yuàn yī shēng shuō wǒ méi shì
items.en: I went to the hospital yesterday and the doctor said I was fine.
items.why: A trip somewhere is counted with 趟. 遍 means going through something from start to finish.

items.q: 医生说这个药很难吃，你把说明书从头到尾读一___再吃。
items.zh: 医生说这个药很难吃，你把说明书从头到尾读一遍再吃。
items.py: yī shēng shuō zhè ge yào hěn nán chī nǐ bǎ shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú yī biàn zài chī
items.en: The doctor said the medicine is hard to take, so read the instructions from beginning to end once before you take it.
items.why: 从头到尾 spells out a full pass through a text, which is 遍. 趟 is for a trip there and back.

items.q: 她感冒好了以后，又去了两___医院复查。
items.zh: 她感冒好了以后，又去了两次医院复查。
items.py: tā gǎn mào hǎo le yǐ hòu yòu qù le liǎng cì yī yuàn fù chá
items.en: After her cold got better she went to the hospital twice more for a check-up.
items.why: Visits are simply occurrences, counted with 次. 遍 needs something read or watched all the way through, and 个 is not a measure for times.

items.q: 护士让我再量一___体温，因为刚才的数字不太准。
items.zh: 护士让我再量一次体温，因为刚才的数字不太准。
items.py: hù shì ràng wǒ zài liáng yī cì tǐ wēn yīn wèi gāng cái de shù zì bù tài zhǔn
items.en: The nurse asked me to take my temperature once more because the earlier reading was not accurate.
items.why: A repeated action is counted with 次. 趟 needs a journey and 场 an event, and 个 does not count actions.

items.q: 今年夏天我感冒了两___，每次都发烧。
items.zh: 今年夏天我感冒了两次，每次都发烧。
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ gǎn mào le liǎng cì měi cì dōu fā shāo
items.en: I caught a cold twice this summer and had a fever each time.
items.why: Occasions of catching a cold are counted with 次. 遍 and 趟 imply going through something or travelling, and 场 is for events.

items.q: 这首关于春天的歌，我从头到尾听了三___，还是没听懂。
items.zh: 这首关于春天的歌，我从头到尾听了三遍，还是没听懂。
items.py: zhè shǒu guān yú chūn tiān de gē wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi tīng le sān biàn hái shì méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I listened to this song about spring three times all the way through and still did not understand it.
items.why: 从头到尾 makes it a full pass through the song, so 遍. 趟 is a journey and 个 does not count times.

items.q: 奶奶住院的时候，爸爸每个星期都要跑好几___医院，一天也没休息过。
items.zh: 奶奶住院的时候，爸爸每个星期都要跑好几趟医院，一天也没休息过。
items.py: nǎi nai zhù yuàn de shí hou bà ba měi gè xīng qī dōu yào pǎo hǎo jǐ tàng yī yuàn yī tiān yě méi xiū xī guò
items.en: When Grandma was in hospital Dad had to make several trips to the hospital every week without a day off.
items.why: Going back and forth to a place is 趟. 遍 is a start-to-finish pass through content, 场 an event and 顿 a meal.

items.q: 这___药都是医生给我的，一天吃三次。
items.zh: 这些药都是医生给我的，一天吃三次。
items.py: zhè xiē yào dōu shì yī shēng gěi wǒ de yī tiān chī sān cì
items.en: These medicines were all given to me by the doctor and I take them three times a day.
items.why: 这些 is the plural 'these' and goes straight on the noun; with 都 it must be plural. 这个药 is singular and 本 is for books.

items.q: 我买了一些___水果，想送给生病的同学。
items.zh: 我买了一些水果，想送给生病的同学。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ xiǎng sòng gěi shēng bìng de tóng xué
items.en: I bought some fruit to give to my classmate who is ill.
items.why: 一些 takes the noun directly, with no second measure. 一些块水果 and 一些片水果 are not Chinese.

items.q: 我只喝了一点儿___水，还是很渴。
items.zh: 我只喝了一点儿水，还是很渴。
items.py: wǒ zhǐ hē le yì diǎn r shuǐ hái shì hěn kě
items.en: I only drank a little water and I was still thirsty.
items.why: 一点儿 fills the measure slot itself, so nothing may follow it. 一点儿杯水 and 一点儿个水 are wrong.

items.q: 那___不爱穿厚衣服的同学，最近都感冒了。
items.zh: 那些不爱穿厚衣服的同学，最近都感冒了。
items.py: nà xiē bù ài chuān hòu yī fu de tóng xué zuì jìn dōu gǎn mào le
items.en: Those classmates who don't like wearing thick clothes have all caught colds recently.
items.why: Several people need the plural 那些 (no second measure). With 都 the subject is plural, so 那个 and 那条 fail.

items.q: 夏天来了，商店里新到了一些___西瓜，又大又便宜。
items.zh: 夏天来了，商店里新到了一些西瓜，又大又便宜。
items.py: xià tiān lái le shāng diàn lǐ xīn dào le yī xiē xī guā yòu dà yòu pián yi
items.en: Summer is here and some new watermelons have arrived in the shop, big and cheap.
items.why: 一些 goes straight on the noun. Adding a measure (一些块西瓜) is a mistake.

items.q: 下了几天雨，衣服都潮了，这___衣服都得拿出去晒。
items.zh: 下了几天雨，衣服都潮了，这些衣服都得拿出去晒。
items.py: xià le jǐ tiān yǔ yī fu dōu cháo le zhè xiē yī fu dōu děi ná chū qù shài
items.en: After several days of rain the clothes are damp, and all these clothes have to be put out in the sun.
items.why: The clothes are many and 都 marks them as plural, so 这些. 这件 and 这条 count a single item.

items.q: 医生说我的病不严重，只要多休息，再吃一点儿___药就能好。
items.zh: 医生说我的病不严重，只要多休息，再吃一点儿药就能好。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ de bìng bù yán zhòng zhǐ yào duō xiū xī zài chī yì diǎn r yào jiù néng hǎo
items.en: The doctor said my illness is not serious: with more rest and a little more medicine I'll recover.
items.why: 一点儿 takes the noun directly. 一点儿片药 and 一点儿种药 add a second measure, which is not allowed.

items.q: 我每___都跑步，身体越来越好。
items.zh: 我每天都跑步，身体越来越好。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu pǎo bù shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo
items.en: I run every day and I am getting healthier.
items.why: 天 is itself a measure, so 每天 takes no 个. 每个天 is wrong, and 每年 would mean every year, not every day.

items.q: 我感冒了，在家休息了两___。
items.zh: 我感冒了，在家休息了两天。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng tiān
items.en: I had a cold and rested at home for two days.
items.why: 两天 needs no 个, because 天 is a measure word on its own.

items.q: 他生病了，在医院住了三___月。
items.zh: 他生病了，在医院住了三个月。
items.py: tā shēng bìng le zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè yuè
items.en: He was ill and stayed in hospital for three months.
items.why: Counting months needs 个: 三个月. Without it 三月 means March.

items.q: 医生让我休息两___星期，不能去上班。
items.zh: 医生让我休息两个星期，不能去上班。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ xiū xī liǎng gè xīng qī bù néng qù shàng bān
items.en: The doctor told me to rest for two weeks and not go to work.
items.why: 星期 is a noun and takes 个 when counted: 两个星期. 两天星期 and 两年星期 are not Chinese.

items.q: 他每天睡八___小时，所以身体很好。
items.zh: 他每天睡八个小时，所以身体很好。
items.py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
items.en: He sleeps eight hours a day, so he is in good health.
items.why: 小时 is a noun that takes 个: 八个小时. 八天小时 and 八次小时 do not exist.

items.q: 这个夏天特别热，已经三___月没下雨了。
items.zh: 这个夏天特别热，已经三个月没下雨了。
items.py: zhè ge xià tiān tè bié rè yǐ jīng sān gè yuè méi xià yǔ le
items.en: This summer has been very hot and it has not rained for three months.
items.why: Counting months needs 个: 三个月. 三月 would be March. 三年 would be a different length of time and does not match the cue.

items.q: 我们这里的冬天很长，一年有四___月都在下雪。
items.zh: 我们这里的冬天很长，一年有四个月都在下雪。
items.py: wǒ men zhè lǐ de dōng tiān hěn cháng yī nián yǒu sì gè yuè dōu zài xià xuě
items.en: Winters are long here and it snows for four months of the year.
items.why: A count of months needs 个: 四个月. 四月 is April, and 四天 would be only four days.

items.q: 我在南方住了五___，已经习惯了这里又湿又热的夏天。
items.zh: 我在南方住了五年，已经习惯了这里又湿又热的夏天。
items.py: wǒ zài nán fāng zhù le wǔ nián yǐ jīng xí guàn le zhè lǐ yòu shī yòu rè de xià tiān
items.en: I lived in the south for five years and have got used to the hot, damp summers there.
items.why: 年 is already a measure, so 五年 takes no 个. 五个年 is wrong.

items.q: 医生说，每___星期至少要运动三次，每次三十分钟。
items.zh: 医生说，每个星期至少要运动三次，每次三十分钟。
items.py: yī shēng shuō měi gè xīng qī zhì shǎo yào yùn dòng sān cì měi cì sān shí fēn zhōng
items.en: The doctor said you should exercise at least three times every week, thirty minutes each time.
items.why: 星期 needs 个 when 每 is used: 每个星期. 每天星期 and 每次星期 are not Chinese.

items.q: 这几___夏天越来越热，大家都买了空调。
items.zh: 这几年夏天越来越热，大家都买了空调。
items.py: zhè jǐ nián xià tiān yuè lái yuè rè dà jiā dōu mǎi le kōng tiáo
items.en: Summers have been getting hotter in recent years and everyone has bought an air conditioner.
items.why: 年 is a measure itself, so 这几年 takes no 个. 这几个年 is wrong.

items.q: 他一直发烧，在家躺了半___月才好。
items.zh: 他一直发烧，在家躺了半个月才好。
items.py: tā yì zhí fā shāo zài jiā tǎng le bàn gè yuè cái hǎo
items.en: He kept running a fever and lay at home for half a month before he got better.
items.why: Months are counted with 个: 半个月. 半天 is half a day and 半年 half a year, neither of which matches the cue.

items.zh: 医生给我开了三种药。
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le sān zhǒng yào
items.en: The doctor prescribed me three kinds of medicine.
items.why: The measure 种 attaches to the number (三种) and both go before the noun 药; the number cannot follow it.

items.zh: 今天下了一场大雪。
items.py: jīn tiān xià le yī chǎng dà xuě
items.en: It snowed heavily today.
items.why: The number and measure 一场 sit between the verb 下了 and the noun 大雪, and the time word stays in front.

items.zh: 我每天喝八杯水。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān hē bā bēi shuǐ
items.en: I drink eight cups of water every day.
items.why: 八杯 is number plus container measure, directly before the noun 水, with no 个 or 的 in between.

items.zh: 他在医院住了两个月。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le liǎng gè yuè
items.en: He stayed in hospital for two months.
items.why: A length of time goes after the verb: 住了两个月. 两个月 keeps 个 because 月 is a noun, and it cannot come before the verb.

items.zh: 这三种药都要饭后吃。
items.py: zhè sān zhǒng yào dōu yào fàn hòu chī
items.en: All three of these medicines have to be taken after meals.
items.why: With 这 and a number the order is 这 + 三 + 种 + 药. 三 comes between 这 and the measure, never before 这.

items.zh: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ
items.en: It rained heavily last night.
items.why: 一场 goes right before 大雨 and after 下了, the same way a number and measure precede any noun.

items.zh: 医院门口有两棵很大的树。
items.py: yī yuàn mén kǒu yǒu liǎng kē hěn dà de shù
items.en: There are two very big trees at the hospital entrance.
items.why: The number and measure 两棵 go before the whole description 很大的树, because the measure comes straight after the number.

items.zh: 妈妈给我买了一双防滑的鞋。
items.py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng fáng huá de xié
items.en: Mum bought me a pair of non-slip shoes.
items.why: 一双 is number plus measure for shoes, placed before the modifier 防滑的 and the noun 鞋.

items.zh: 去年我在北京住了三个月。
items.py: qù nián wǒ zài běi jīng zhù le sān gè yuè
items.en: Last year I lived in Beijing for three months.
items.why: The duration 三个月 follows the verb 住了. 个 stays because 月 is a noun; a time word like 去年 may stand before or after 我.

items.s: 医生给我开了两药。
items.s_py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le liǎng yào
items.zh: 医生给我开了两种药。
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le liǎng zhǒng yào
items.en: The doctor prescribed me two kinds of medicine.
items.why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun; 种 must come between 两 and 药.

items.s: 我发烧了，在家休息了两个天。
items.s_py: wǒ fā shāo le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng gè tiān
items.zh: 我发烧了，在家休息了两天。
items.py: wǒ fā shāo le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng tiān
items.en: I had a fever and rested at home for two days.
items.why: 天 is itself a measure word, so 个 cannot come between 两 and 天.

items.s: 医生让我每天吃三趟药。
items.s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān tàng yào
items.zh: 医生让我每天吃三次药。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān cì yào
items.en: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day.
items.why: 趟 counts trips there and back; taking medicine is an occurrence, so 次.

items.s: 我每个天都去公园跑步。
items.s_py: wǒ měi gè tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.zh: 我每天都去公园跑步。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I go jogging in the park every day.
items.why: 天 is already a measure, so 每天 takes no 个.

items.s: 我买了一些片药。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē piàn yào
items.zh: 我买了一些药。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē yào
items.en: I bought some medicine.
items.why: 一些 goes directly on the noun and a second measure like 片 cannot be added.

items.s: 医生的办公室在三间，请坐电梯上去。
items.s_py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài sān jiān qǐng zuò diàn tī shàng qù
items.zh: 医生的办公室在三层，请坐电梯上去。
items.py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài sān céng qǐng zuò diàn tī shàng qù
items.en: The doctor's office is on the third floor, so please take the lift up.
items.why: Floors are counted with 层; 间 counts rooms, so 三间 cannot name a floor.

items.s: 外面有一位人在等医生。
items.s_py: wài miàn yǒu yī wèi rén zài děng yī shēng
items.zh: 外面有一个人在等医生。
items.py: wài miàn yǒu yí gè rén zài děng yī shēng
items.en: There is someone outside waiting for the doctor.
items.why: 位 is not used before bare 人; use 个, or put 位 before a role such as 客人 or 病人.

items.s: 夏天太热，我买了一辆空调。
items.s_py: xià tiān tài rè wǒ mǎi le yī liàng kōng tiáo
items.zh: 夏天太热，我买了一台空调。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè wǒ mǎi le yī tái kōng tiáo
items.en: It was so hot in summer that I bought an air conditioner.
items.why: 辆 counts vehicles; an air conditioner is a machine, so 台.

items.s: 我想买一条外套，下雪的时候穿。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tiáo wài tào xià xuě de shí hou chuān
items.zh: 我想买一件外套，下雪的时候穿。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn wài tào xià xuě de shí hou chuān
items.en: I want to buy a coat to wear when it snows.
items.why: 条 is for trousers, skirts and other long bendy things; a coat is a top, so 件.

items.s: 冬天的时候，我们这里每个年都下很大的雪。
items.s_py: dōng tiān de shí hou wǒ men zhè lǐ měi gè nián dōu xià hěn dà de xuě
items.zh: 冬天的时候，我们这里每年都下很大的雪。
items.py: dōng tiān de shí hou wǒ men zhè lǐ měi nián dōu xià hěn dà de xuě
items.en: In winter it snows heavily here every year.
items.why: 年 is a measure itself, so 每年 takes no 个.

items.s: 医生让我把这份说明书从头到尾读两趟。
items.s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú liǎng tàng
items.zh: 医生让我把这份说明书从头到尾读两遍。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú liǎng biàn
items.en: The doctor told me to read this instruction sheet twice from beginning to end.
items.why: Reading all the way through is 遍. 趟 needs a journey, and reading a sheet is not one.

items.s: 我们家有三口人，都爱喝热茶。
items.s_py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén dōu ài hē rè chá
items.zh: 我们家有三口人，都爱喝热茶。
items.py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén dōu ài hē rè chá
items.en: There are three of us in the family and we all like hot tea.
items.why: Family members are counted with 口, so 三口人 is correct.

items.s: 那位医生很年轻，可是看病很认真。
items.s_py: nà wèi yī shēng hěn nián qīng kě shì kàn bìng hěn rèn zhēn
items.zh: 那位医生很年轻，可是看病很认真。
items.py: nà wèi yī shēng hěn nián qīng kě shì kàn bìng hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: That doctor is young but very conscientious with patients.
items.why: 位 is the polite measure before a role word like 医生, so 那位医生 is correct.

items.s: 她感冒了，在家躺了两个星期。
items.s_py: tā gǎn mào le zài jiā tǎng le liǎng gè xīng qī
items.zh: 她感冒了，在家躺了两个星期。
items.py: tā gǎn mào le zài jiā tǎng le liǎng gè xīng qī
items.en: She had a cold and lay at home for two weeks.
items.why: 星期 is a noun that takes 个, so 两个星期 is correct.

items.s: 他每天睡七个小时，可是还是觉得累。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí kě shì hái shì jué de lèi
items.zh: 他每天睡七个小时，可是还是觉得累。
items.py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí kě shì hái shì jué de lèi
items.en: He sleeps seven hours every day and still feels tired.
items.why: 每天 takes no 个 but 小时 does, so 七个小时 is correct.

items.s: 一连下了三天雨，河水涨得很高。
items.s_py: yī lián xià le sān tiān yǔ hé shuǐ zhǎng de hěn gāo
items.zh: 一连下了三天雨，河水涨得很高。
items.py: yī lián xià le sān tiān yǔ hé shuǐ zhǎng de hěn gāo
items.en: It rained for three days in a row and the river rose very high.
items.why: 天 takes no 个, so 三天 is correct and 三个天 would be wrong.

items.s: 这些药一天吃两次，每次一片。
items.s_py: zhè xiē yào yī tiān chī liǎng cì měi cì yī piàn
items.zh: 这些药一天吃两次，每次一片。
items.py: zhè xiē yào yī tiān chī liǎng cì měi cì yī piàn
items.en: Take these medicines twice a day, one tablet each time.
items.why: 这些 goes straight on 药 with no further measure; 次 and 片 count the times and tablets.

items.s: 这几年冬天越来越暖和，下雪的次数比以前少多了。
items.s_py: zhè jǐ nián dōng tiān yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo xià xuě de cì shù bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le
items.zh: 这几年冬天越来越暖和，下雪的次数比以前少多了。
items.py: zhè jǐ nián dōng tiān yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo xià xuě de cì shù bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le
items.en: Winters have got warmer in recent years and it snows much less often than before.
items.why: 年 takes no 个, so 这几年 is correct.

items.s: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨，今天早上路上还有很多水。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ jīn tiān zǎo shàng lù shàng hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
items.zh: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨，今天早上路上还有很多水。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ jīn tiān zǎo shàng lù shàng hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
items.en: There was heavy rain last night and the road still has a lot of water this morning.
items.why: A fall of rain is counted with 场, so 一场大雨 is correct.

items.s: 我想喝一点儿热水，再吃一片药。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng hē yì diǎn r rè shuǐ zài chī yī piàn yào
items.zh: 我想喝一点儿热水，再吃一片药。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng hē yì diǎn r rè shuǐ zài chī yī piàn yào
items.en: I'd like a little hot water and then to take a tablet.
items.why: 一点儿 goes straight on 热水, while the tablet gets its own measure 片, so both are correct.

items.zh: 他唱了一首很好听的歌。
items.py: tā chàng le yī shǒu hěn hǎo tīng de gē
items.en: He sang a very nice song.
items.why: Songs take 首. The measure sits between 一 and the modifier plus noun.

items.s: 他家的那条狗每天陪他去公园跑步。
items.s_py: tā jiā de nà tiáo gǒu měi tiān péi tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.zh: 他家的那条狗每天陪他去公园跑步。
items.py: tā jiā de nà tiáo gǒu měi tiān péi tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: His dog goes running in the park with him every day.
items.why: Dogs can take 条 as well as 只, so 条 is acceptable here.

items.s: 我给教练写了一个信，请他让我进球队。
items.s_py: wǒ gěi jiào liàn xiě le yí gè xìn qǐng tā ràng wǒ jìn qiú duì
items.zh: 我给教练写了一封信，请他让我进球队。
items.py: wǒ gěi jiào liàn xiě le yī fēng xìn qǐng tā ràng wǒ jìn qiú duì
items.en: I wrote the coach a letter asking him to let me join the team.
items.why: Letters take 封. 个 is not a universal substitute.

items.q: 那___孩子每天下午都在公园打羽毛球。
items.zh: 那个孩子每天下午都在公园打羽毛球。
items.py: nà ge hái zi měi tiān xià wǔ dōu zài gōng yuán dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: That child plays badminton in the park every afternoon.
items.why: One child: 那 + 个 + noun. 那些 would mean 'those children', and the English cue is singular.

items.q: 妈妈给我准备了一___早饭，有鸡蛋和牛奶，让我吃完再去踢球。
items.zh: 妈妈给我准备了一份早饭，有鸡蛋和牛奶，让我吃完再去踢球。
items.py: mā mā gěi wǒ zhǔn bèi le yī fèn zǎo fàn yǒu jī dàn hé niú nǎi ràng wǒ chī wán zài qù tī qiú
items.en: Mum prepared a breakfast for me, with eggs and milk, and told me to finish it before going to play football.
items.why: A prepared portion of food is a 份. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets and 瓶 for bottles.

items.q: 他上个月到体育学院去了两___，每次都是坐地铁去、坐地铁回。
items.zh: 他上个月到体育学院去了两趟，每次都是坐地铁去、坐地铁回。
items.py: tā shàng gè yuè dào tǐ yù xué yuàn qù le liǎng tàng měi cì dōu shì zuò dì tiě qù zuò dì tiě huí
items.en: Last month he went to the sports institute twice, each time going and coming back by subway.
items.why: Trips there and back are counted with 趟. 遍 is for passes through a text, and 个 and 首 do not count journeys.

items.q: 请给我来一杯___咖啡。
items.zh: 请给我来一杯咖啡。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ lái yī bēi kā fēi
items.en: Please give me a cup of coffee.
items.why: 杯 is already the measure, so nothing goes between 杯 and 咖啡. 一杯的咖啡 and 一杯个咖啡 are both wrong.

items.zh: 桌子上有一杯咖啡。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bēi kā fēi
items.en: There is a cup of coffee on the table.
items.why: 杯 is already the measure, so 一杯咖啡 needs nothing more. The existential 有 follows the place.

items.q: 这位运动员练了十___年才得到第一块金牌。
items.zh: 这位运动员练了十年才得到第一块金牌。
items.py: zhè wèi yùn dòng yuán liàn le shí nián cái dé dào dì yī kuài jīn pái
items.en: This athlete trained for ten years before winning his first gold medal.
items.why: 年 is itself a measure, so 十年 and never 十个年. 个 would be wrong even with a large number.

items.q: 我住在八___，坐电梯很方便。
items.zh: 我住在八层，坐电梯很方便。
items.py: wǒ zhù zài bā céng zuò diàn tī hěn fāng biàn
items.en: I live on the eighth floor, and it is easy to take the lift.
items.why: A floor of a building is 层. 座 would count whole buildings, 间 rooms and 家 businesses.

items.s: 我们昨天看了一首电影。
items.s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn le yī shǒu diàn yǐng
items.zh: 我们昨天看了一部电影。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn le yī bù diàn yǐng
items.en: We watched a film yesterday.
items.why: Films take 部. 首 is only for songs and poems.

items.q: 公园里有两___大树，下面有很多人在打太极拳。
items.zh: 公园里有两棵大树，下面有很多人在打太极拳。
items.py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu liǎng kē dà shù xià miàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài dǎ tài jí quán
items.en: There are two big trees in the park, and many people are doing tai chi under them.
items.why: Trees take 棵. 朵 is for flowers, and 片 would mean a patch or slice, not a whole tree.

items.q: 足球比赛前，我们在球场边买了十___水，分给队员们喝。
items.zh: 足球比赛前，我们在球场边买了十瓶水，分给队员们喝。
items.py: zú qiú bǐ sài qián wǒ men zài qiú chǎng biān mǎi le shí píng shuǐ fēn gěi duì yuán men hē
items.en: Before the football match we bought ten bottles of water by the pitch and shared them out among the players.
items.why: Water bought in bottles is counted with 瓶: 十瓶水. 个 would count items, 双 is for pairs and 份 for portions.

items.s: 球场上有一位人在跑步。
items.s_py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu yī wèi rén zài pǎo bù
items.zh: 球场上有一个人在跑步。
items.py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu yí gè rén zài pǎo bù
items.en: There is someone running on the pitch.
items.why: 位 is polite and goes before a role word, not before bare 人.

items.s: 我弟弟有一双很大的足球鞋。
items.s_py: wǒ dì di yǒu yī shuāng hěn dà de zú qiú xié
items.zh: 我弟弟有一双很大的足球鞋。
items.py: wǒ dì di yǒu yī shuāng hěn dà de zú qiú xié
items.en: My younger brother has a pair of very big football boots.
items.why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双 is right even with a long modifier.

items.zh: 我昨天去了一趟医院。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng yī yuàn
items.en: I made a trip to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: A trip takes 趟 and it goes after the verb 了 and before the place: 去了一趟医院.

items.s: 跑完步我想喝一个杯水。
items.s_py: pǎo wán bù wǒ xiǎng hē yí gè bēi shuǐ
items.zh: 跑完步我想喝一杯水。
items.py: pǎo wán bù wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi shuǐ
items.en: After running I want a glass of water.
items.why: 杯 is already the measure for a drink, so 个 must not go before it.

items.q: 这场比赛要打两___小时，你先吃点东西吧。
items.zh: 这场比赛要打两个小时，你先吃点东西吧。
items.py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yào dǎ liǎng gè xiǎo shí nǐ xiān chī diǎn dōng xī ba
items.en: This match takes two hours to play, so eat something first.
items.why: Hours are counted with 个 in a sentence like this: 两个小时. 场 and 次 count events and occasions, not time lengths.

items.s: 这个学期我有三门课，每周共有十二节课。
items.s_py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ yǒu sān mén kè měi zhōu gòng yǒu shí èr jié kè
items.zh: 这个学期我有三门课，每周共有十二节课。
items.py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ yǒu sān mén kè měi zhōu gòng yǒu shí èr jié kè
items.en: This term I have three courses and twelve class periods a week.
items.why: 门 counts subjects and 节 counts timetable periods, so both are right.

items.zh: 桌子上有一些水果。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
items.en: There is some fruit on the table.
items.why: 一些 goes straight onto the noun with no other measure in between.

items.q: 我想买两___看球赛的票。
items.zh: 我想买两张看球赛的票。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng zhāng kàn qiú sài de piào
items.en: I want to buy two tickets for the match.
items.why: Tickets are flat, so 张. 本 is for bound volumes and 件 for clothes and matters.

items.zh: 我们学校有两座体育馆。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu liǎng zuò tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Our school has two gyms.
items.why: Big fixed buildings take 座 and the number comes before the measure.

items.q: ___篮球都是新的，今天第一次用。
items.zh: 这三个篮球都是新的，今天第一次用。
items.py: zhè sān gè lán qiú dōu shì xīn de jīn tiān dì yī cì yòng
items.en: These three basketballs are all new; we are using them for the first time today.
items.why: Pointing word, then number, then measure: 这三个篮球. 三这个 and 这个三 put the pieces in the wrong order.

items.zh: 这三本书都是我的。
items.py: zhè sān běn shū dōu shì wǒ de
items.en: These three books are all mine.
items.why: Pointing word, number, measure, noun: 这三本书. The measure cannot come before the number.

items.q: 那些___球拍都是教练送给我们的。
items.zh: 那些球拍都是教练送给我们的。
items.py: nà xiē qiú pāi dōu shì jiào liàn sòng gěi wǒ men de
items.en: Those rackets were all given to us by the coach.
items.why: 些 already fills the measure slot. 那些把球拍 and 那些支球拍 add a second measure, which is wrong.

items.q: 这条街上有___商店，有的卖运动鞋，有的卖自行车。
items.zh: 这条街上有一些商店，有的卖运动鞋，有的卖自行车。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu yī xiē shāng diàn yǒu de mài yùn dòng xié yǒu de mài zì xíng chē
items.en: On this street there are some shops; some sell trainers and some sell bicycles.
items.why: 一些 is for countable things. 三些 is impossible because 些 only goes with 一, and 一点儿 is for uncountable amounts.

items.q: 钓鱼的时候他运气很好，一个上午就钓到了五___大鱼。
items.zh: 钓鱼的时候他运气很好，一个上午就钓到了五条大鱼。
items.py: diào yú de shí hòu tā yùn qì hěn hǎo yí gè shàng wǔ jiù diào dào le wǔ tiáo dà yú
items.en: He was lucky while fishing and caught five big fish in a single morning.
items.why: Fish take 条. 只 and 头 are for land animals, and 匹 is for horses.

items.q: 我学了三___年游泳。
items.zh: 我学了三年游泳。
items.py: wǒ xué le sān nián yóu yǒng
items.en: I have studied swimming for three years.
items.why: 年 is itself a measure, so the number goes straight on: 三年. 三个年 is wrong.

items.s: 这位是我们的新教练，他以前在北京踢过球。
items.s_py: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn jiào liàn tā yǐ qián zài běi jīng tī guò qiú
items.zh: 这位是我们的新教练，他以前在北京踢过球。
items.py: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn jiào liàn tā yǐ qián zài běi jīng tī guò qiú
items.en: This is our new coach; he used to play football in Beijing.
items.why: 位 is correct before a role word and is polite when introducing someone.

items.q: 这___书都是我借来的，不是买的。
items.zh: 这些书都是我借来的，不是买的。
items.py: zhè xiē shū dōu shì wǒ jiè lái de bú shì mǎi de
items.en: These books are all ones I borrowed, not bought.
items.why: 都 shows several books: 这些书. 这本书 is one book, and 这个书 is not the standard way to say it.

items.q: 李教练，您好，这___是我们队的新队员小王。
items.zh: 李教练，您好，这位是我们队的新队员小王。
items.py: lǐ jiào liàn nín hǎo zhè wèi shì wǒ men duì de xīn duì yuán xiǎo wáng
items.en: Hello, Coach Li, this is Xiao Wang, a new player in our team.
items.why: Introducing someone to a senior person calls for the polite 位 before the role. 口, 家 and 座 do not count people this way.

items.q: 周末我要去一___书店，顺便给你买本词典。
items.zh: 周末我要去一趟书店，顺便给你买本词典。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ yào qù yī tàng shū diàn shùn biàn gěi nǐ mǎi běn cí diǎn
items.en: This weekend I'm going to the bookshop, and I will buy you a dictionary on the way.
items.why: A trip to a place and back is counted with 趟. 遍 needs something to be gone through from start to finish, and 场 counts events, not journeys.

items.q: 我买了一些___水果，周末带去公园。
items.zh: 我买了一些水果，周末带去公园。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ zhōu mò dài qù gōng yuán
items.en: I bought some fruit to take to the park at the weekend.
items.why: 一些 already fills the measure slot, so no other measure follows. 一些个水果 and 一些件水果 are wrong.

items.s: 河上有一间很长的桥，骑车要十分钟。
items.s_py: hé shàng yǒu yī jiān hěn cháng de qiáo qí chē yào shí fēn zhōng
items.zh: 河上有一座很长的桥，骑车要十分钟。
items.py: hé shàng yǒu yī zuò hěn cháng de qiáo qí chē yào shí fēn zhōng
items.en: There is a very long bridge over the river; it takes ten minutes to cycle across.
items.why: Bridges take 座. 间 is only for rooms.

items.q: 体育馆外面停着一___白色的车。
items.zh: 体育馆外面停着一辆白色的车。
items.py: tǐ yù guǎn wài miàn tíng zhe yī liàng bái sè de chē
items.en: A white car is parked outside the gym.
items.why: Anything on wheels takes 辆. 台 is for machines, 部 for phones, 匹 for horses.

items.s: 他在城里买了一件黑色的裤子。
items.s_py: tā zài chéng lǐ mǎi le yī jiàn hēi sè de kù zi
items.zh: 他在城里买了一条黑色的裤子。
items.py: tā zài chéng lǐ mǎi le yī tiáo hēi sè de kù zi
items.en: He bought a pair of black trousers in town.
items.why: Trousers take 条. 件 is for tops and matters.

items.q: 比赛结束后，教练给每个队员发了一___蛋糕。
items.zh: 比赛结束后，教练给每个队员发了一块蛋糕。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu jiào liàn gěi měi gè duì yuán fā le yī kuài dàn gāo
items.en: After the match the coach gave each player a piece of cake.
items.why: A piece cut from a cake is 块. 封 is for letters, 朵 for flowers and 棵 for trees.

items.q: 他在花店买了一___红玫瑰，送给女朋友。
items.zh: 他在花店买了一朵红玫瑰，送给女朋友。
items.py: tā zài huā diàn mǎi le yī duǒ hóng méi guī sòng gěi nǚ péng yǒu
items.en: He bought one red rose at the florist's and gave it to his girlfriend.
items.why: A single flower counts with 朵. 棵 is for trees and plants, and 封 is for letters.

items.s: 公园门口停着一只自行车。
items.s_py: gōng yuán mén kǒu tíng zhe yī zhī zì xíng chē
items.zh: 公园门口停着一辆自行车。
items.py: gōng yuán mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng zì xíng chē
items.en: A bicycle is parked at the park entrance.
items.why: Anything with wheels takes 辆. 只 is for small animals.

items.q: 我最喜欢听这___歌，每次跑步都听。
items.zh: 我最喜欢听这首歌，每次跑步都听。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān tīng zhè shǒu gē měi cì pǎo bù dōu tīng
items.en: I like listening to this song best; I play it every time I run.
items.why: Songs take 首. 部 is for films and novels, 门 for subjects, 节 for class periods.

items.q: 裁判把比赛规则从头到尾说了一___，大家才听明白。
items.zh: 裁判把比赛规则从头到尾说了一遍，大家才听明白。
items.py: cái pàn bǎ bǐ sài guī zé cóng tóu dào wěi shuō le yī biàn dà jiā cái tīng míng bái
items.en: The referee went through the rules from start to finish before everyone understood.
items.why: Going through all the rules from beginning to end is 遍. 趟 is for journeys and 个 does not count passes.

items.s: 我买了三些苹果。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi le sān xiē píng guǒ
items.zh: 我买了一些苹果。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē píng guǒ
items.en: I bought some apples.
items.why: 些 only combines with 一; with other numbers use a real measure such as 个.

items.zh: 门口停着一辆红色的车。
items.py: mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng hóng sè de chē
items.en: A red car is parked at the door.
items.why: A car has wheels: 辆. The place comes first and the thing that is there comes last.

items.q: 这___山不太高，我们一个上午就爬上去了。
items.zh: 这座山不太高，我们一个上午就爬上去了。
items.py: zhè zuò shān bù tài gāo wǒ men yí gè shàng wǔ jiù pá shàng qù le
items.en: This mountain is not very high; we climbed it in one morning.
items.why: Mountains take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses and 层 for floors.

items.q: 他用一___钢笔把比赛成绩记在了本子上。
items.zh: 他用一支钢笔把比赛成绩记在了本子上。
items.py: tā yòng yī zhī gāng bǐ bǎ bǐ sài chéng jì jì zài le běn zi shàng
items.en: He wrote the match results in his notebook with a fountain pen.
items.why: Pens take 支. 把 is for handled things, and 张 for flat sheets.

items.q: 那___体育馆很大，可以同时坐五万人看比赛。
items.zh: 那座体育馆很大，可以同时坐五万人看比赛。
items.py: nà zuò tǐ yù guǎn hěn dà kě yǐ tóng shí zuò wǔ wàn rén kàn bǐ sài
items.en: That stadium is huge and can seat fifty thousand people to watch a match at the same time.
items.why: Huge fixed buildings take 座. 间 is for rooms, 家 for businesses, 层 for floors.

items.q: 这个学期我选了三___选修课，有游泳、摄影和书法。
items.zh: 这个学期我选了三门选修课，有游泳、摄影和书法。
items.py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le sān mén xuǎn xiū kè yǒu yóu yǒng shè yǐng hé shū fǎ
items.en: This term I chose three elective courses: swimming, photography and calligraphy.
items.why: Three different subjects are 三门课. 节 would count class periods, and 首 and 顿 are for songs and meals.

items.q: 他每个星期游三___泳。
items.zh: 他每个星期游三次泳。
items.py: tā měi gè xīng qī yóu sān cì yǒng
items.en: He swims three times a week.
items.why: How often an action happens is counted with 次 after the verb. 个 does not count occasions and 遍 means a full pass.

items.q: 昨天晚上我们看了一___很精彩的足球比赛。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我们看了一场很精彩的足球比赛。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men kàn le yī chǎng hěn jīng cǎi de zú qiú bǐ sài
items.en: Last night we watched a really exciting football match.
items.why: A match is an event that runs its course: 场. 首 is for songs, 节 for class periods and 顿 for meals.

items.q: 我们在球场旁边的小店吃了两___面条。
items.zh: 我们在球场旁边的小店吃了两碗面条。
items.py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng páng biān de xiǎo diàn chī le liǎng wǎn miàn tiáo
items.en: We ate two bowls of noodles at the little shop next to the sports ground.
items.why: The bowl is the measure for noodles: 两碗面条. 双 is for pairs, 件 for clothes, 套 for sets.

items.q: 新开的健身房里有二十___跑步机。
items.zh: 新开的健身房里有二十台跑步机。
items.py: xīn kāi de jiàn shēn fáng lǐ yǒu èr shí tái pǎo bù jī
items.en: The new gym has twenty treadmills.
items.why: A treadmill is a machine, so 台. 辆 is for wheeled vehicles and 只 for small animals.

items.q: 我们班每___学生都喜欢运动。
items.zh: 我们班每个学生都喜欢运动。
items.py: wǒ men bān měi gè xué shēng dōu xǐ huān yùn dòng
items.en: Every student in our class likes sports.
items.why: 每 needs a measure before the noun: 每个学生. 每学生 drops it, and 每的学生 is not Chinese.

items.s: 球员们每人喝了一瓶水，然后继续练习。
items.zh: 球员们每人喝了一瓶水，然后继续练习。
items.py: qiú yuán men měi rén hē le yī píng shuǐ rán hòu jì xù liàn xí
items.en: Each player drank a bottle of water and then went on practising.
items.why: 瓶 is already the measure, so 一瓶水 needs nothing between 瓶 and 水. The sentence is correct as written.

items.q: 我去过两___上海，都是去看球赛。
items.zh: 我去过两次上海，都是去看球赛。
items.py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì shàng hǎi dōu shì qù kàn qiú sài
items.en: I have been to Shanghai twice, both times to watch a match.
items.why: Counting visits uses 次. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, and 个 does not count times.

items.s: 每个队员都有一件红色的球衣。
items.s_py: měi gè duì yuán dōu yǒu yī jiàn hóng sè de qiú yī
items.zh: 每个队员都有一件红色的球衣。
items.py: měi gè duì yuán dōu yǒu yī jiàn hóng sè de qiú yī
items.en: Every player has a red jersey.
items.why: 每个 plus noun is the right shape, and 件 is the measure for a top.

items.q: 这本小说很好看，我已经从头到尾读了三___。
items.zh: 这本小说很好看，我已经从头到尾读了三遍。
items.py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō hěn hǎo kàn wǒ yǐ jīng cóng tóu dào wěi dú le sān biàn
items.en: This novel is great; I have read it from beginning to end three times.
items.why: Reading from start to finish is 遍. 趟 counts trips and 个 counts objects, not passes through a book.

items.q: 他每个星期六下午都有一___钢琴课，一上就是两个小时。
items.zh: 他每个星期六下午都有一节钢琴课，一上就是两个小时。
items.py: tā měi gè xīng qī liù xià wǔ dōu yǒu yī jié gāng qín kè yī shàng jiù shì liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: Every Saturday afternoon he has a piano lesson, which lasts two hours.
items.why: A single lesson slot takes 节. 门 would be a whole subject or course, and 首 and 顿 do not fit 课.

items.q: 你们几___人一起去打球？
items.zh: 你们几个人一起去打球？
items.py: nǐ men jǐ gè rén yì qǐ qù dǎ qiú
items.en: How many of you are going to play ball together?
items.why: 几 needs a measure before the noun: 几个人. 几人 drops it, and 口 only counts family members, which does not fit a game.

items.q: 他骑着一___马在草地上跑了一圈。
items.zh: 他骑着一匹马在草地上跑了一圈。
items.py: tā qí zhe yì pǐ mǎ zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo le yī quān
items.en: He rode a horse once round the grass.
items.why: Horses take 匹. 条 is for fish, 只 for small animals and 头 for cattle and pigs.

items.s: 他在这个队踢了三个年球。
items.s_py: tā zài zhè ge duì tī le sān gè nián qiú
items.zh: 他在这个队踢了三年球。
items.py: tā zài zhè ge duì tī le sān nián qiú
items.en: He has played football in this team for three years.
items.why: 年 is itself a measure, so 三年, never 三个年.

items.q: 公园里有一___小鸟在树上唱歌。
items.zh: 公园里有一只小鸟在树上唱歌。
items.py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo zài shù shàng chàng gē
items.en: There is a little bird singing in a tree in the park.
items.why: Small animals and birds take 只. 条 is for fish, 头 for cattle and pigs, 匹 for horses.

items.s: 我们班有三学生喜欢游泳。
items.s_py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān xué shēng xǐ huān yóu yǒng
items.zh: 我们班有三个学生喜欢游泳。
items.py: wǒ men bān yǒu sān gè xué shēng xǐ huān yóu yǒng
items.en: Three students in our class like swimming.
items.why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun; 学生 needs the measure 个 in between.

items.q: 比赛前，有两___老教练在场边给我们讲了话。
items.zh: 比赛前，有两位老教练在场边给我们讲了话。
items.py: bǐ sài qián yǒu liǎng wèi lǎo jiào liàn zài chǎng biān gěi wǒ men jiǎng le huà
items.en: Before the match two senior coaches spoke to us at the side of the pitch.
items.why: Respected people are counted with 位 before their role word. 口 is for family members, 家 for businesses, 座 for big structures.

items.q: 他每___天都去公园跑步。
items.zh: 他每天都去公园跑步。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: He goes running in the park every day.
items.why: 天 is itself a measure, so no 个: 每天. 每个天 is wrong.

items.q: 他拍了一___讲足球的电影，很受欢迎。
items.zh: 他拍了一部讲足球的电影，很受欢迎。
items.py: tā pāi le yī bù jiǎng zú qiú de diàn yǐng hěn shòu huān yíng
items.en: He made a film about football and it was very popular.
items.why: A film as a work takes 部. 场 would be one showing, which does not fit 拍 'make'.

items.q: 俱乐部在城里给球员租了一___房子，有三间卧室和两个卫生间。
items.zh: 俱乐部在城里给球员租了一套房子，有三间卧室和两个卫生间。
items.py: jù lè bù zài chéng lǐ gěi qiú yuán zū le yī tào fáng zi yǒu sān jiān wò shì hé liǎng gè wèi shēng jiān
items.en: The club rented a flat in the city for the players, with three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
items.why: A flat or house as a self-contained unit takes 套. 份 is for portions and jobs, 双 for pairs, 瓶 for bottles.

items.s: 我每个月去一次北京，每次住三天。
items.s_py: wǒ měi gè yuè qù yī cì běi jīng měi cì zhù sān tiān
items.zh: 我每个月去一次北京，每次住三天。
items.py: wǒ měi gè yuè qù yī cì běi jīng měi cì zhù sān tiān
items.en: I go to Beijing once a month and stay three days each time.
items.why: 月 takes 个 but 天 never does, and 次 counts the visits.

items.q: 周三上午我们有两___体育课，八点开始。
items.zh: 周三上午我们有两节体育课，八点开始。
items.py: zhōu sān shàng wǔ wǒ men yǒu liǎng jié tǐ yù kè bā diǎn kāi shǐ
items.en: On Wednesday morning we have two PE periods, starting at eight.
items.why: Two periods on the timetable are 两节课. 门 would mean two separate subjects.

items.q: 他毕业以后找到了一___在体育杂志社的工作。
items.zh: 他毕业以后找到了一份在体育杂志社的工作。
items.py: tā bì yè yǐ hòu zhǎo dào le yī fèn zài tǐ yù zá zhì shè de gōng zuò
items.en: After graduating he found a job at a sports magazine.
items.why: A job takes 份. 瓶 is for bottles, 套 for sets and 双 for pairs.

items.q: 我家楼下有一___小猫，每天晚上都叫。
items.zh: 我家楼下有一只小猫，每天晚上都叫。
items.py: wǒ jiā lóu xià yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu jiào
items.en: There is a little cat downstairs from my flat that meows every night.
items.why: A cat is a small animal: 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 条 for fish and 匹 for horses.

items.q: 地铁站对面新开了一___咖啡店。
items.zh: 地铁站对面新开了一家咖啡店。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā kā fēi diàn
items.en: A new coffee shop has opened across from the subway station.
items.why: Shops and other businesses take 家. 座 is for big structures, 层 for floors, 位 for polite counting of people.

items.q: 跑完步以后，我想喝一___冰水。
items.zh: 跑完步以后，我想喝一瓶冰水。
items.py: pǎo wán bù yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng hē yī píng bīng shuǐ
items.en: After running I'd like to drink a bottle of iced water.
items.why: A bottle of water is 一瓶水, with no 个. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets, 份 for portions.

items.zh: 体育馆旁边新开了一家很大的运动用品店。
items.py: tǐ yù guǎn páng biān xīn kāi le yī jiā hěn dà de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn
items.en: A very big sports goods shop has opened next to the gym.
items.why: Shops take 家, and the measure comes before the description: 一家很大的运动用品店.

items.q: 你想去哪___公园跑步？
items.zh: 你想去哪个公园跑步？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ ge gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: Which park do you want to run in?
items.why: 哪 needs a measure: 哪个公园. 哪些 asks about several parks, but the cue asks about one.

items.q: 酒店还有一___双人房间，您要吗？
items.zh: 酒店还有一间双人房间，您要吗？
items.py: jiǔ diàn hái yǒu yī jiān shuāng rén fáng jiān nín yào ma
items.en: The hotel still has a double room. Would you like it?
items.why: Rooms take 间. 家 is for the hotel as a business, 座 for large buildings, 层 for floors.

items.q: 这家公司在市中心开了五___分店，生意都很好。
items.zh: 这家公司在市中心开了五家分店，生意都很好。
items.py: zhè jiā gōng sī zài shì zhōng xīn kāi le wǔ jiā fēn diàn shēng yì dōu hěn hǎo
items.en: This company has opened five branches in the city centre, and business is good at all of them.
items.why: Branches are businesses, so 家. 座, 间 and 层 count large buildings, rooms and floors.

items.s: 老师说了一遍，我还是没听懂。
items.s_py: lǎo shī shuō le yī biàn wǒ hái shì méi tīng dǒng
items.zh: 老师说了一遍，我还是没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō le yī biàn wǒ hái shì méi tīng dǒng
items.en: The teacher said it once through, and I still did not understand.
items.why: 遍 is right when the teacher goes through the whole thing once.

items.q: 我们队有十一___人，一起踢足球。
items.zh: 我们队有十一个人，一起踢足球。
items.py: wǒ men duì yǒu shí yí gè rén yì qǐ tī zú qiú
items.en: Our team has eleven people who play football together.
items.why: A plain count of people uses 个. 位 is polite and never goes straight before bare 人, and 口 counts family members.

items.q: 打篮球要穿一___合适的球鞋。
items.zh: 打篮球要穿一双合适的球鞋。
items.py: dǎ lán qiú yào chuān yī shuāng hé shì de qiú xié
items.en: You need to wear a suitable pair of shoes to play basketball.
items.why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 条 is for trousers, 件 for tops and 把 for things with a handle.

items.q: 我们去饭馆吃了一___晚饭，然后去看电影。
items.zh: 我们去饭馆吃了一顿晚饭，然后去看电影。
items.py: wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī le yī dùn wǎn fàn rán hòu qù kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: We had dinner at a restaurant and then went to see a film.
items.why: A meal takes 顿. 场 is for matches and shows, 首 for songs and 部 for films.

items.q: 我们在海边度了两___星期的假，每天都去游泳。
items.zh: 我们在海边度了两个星期的假，每天都去游泳。
items.py: wǒ men zài hǎi biān dù le liǎng gè xīng qī de jiǎ měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: We spent a two-week holiday at the seaside and swam every day.
items.why: Weeks take 个: 两个星期. 次 and 条 are not measures for weeks.

items.q: 我打算在北京住两___月，每天去公园打太极拳。
items.zh: 我打算在北京住两个月，每天去公园打太极拳。
items.py: wǒ dǎ suàn zài běi jīng zhù liǎng gè yuè měi tiān qù gōng yuán dǎ tài jí quán
items.en: I plan to live in Beijing for two months and go and do tai chi in the park every day.
items.why: Counting months needs 个: 两个月. Without 个, 月 reads as a calendar month name (三月 is March), not a length of time.

items.q: 那___楼有三十层，是这个城市最高的。
items.zh: 那座楼有三十层，是这个城市最高的。
items.py: nà zuò lóu yǒu sān shí céng shì zhè ge chéng shì zuì gāo de
items.en: That building has thirty floors and is the tallest in the city.
items.why: A tall building is a large fixed structure: 座. 间 is for rooms and 家 for businesses.

items.q: 他在运动商店买了一___新裤子。
items.zh: 他在运动商店买了一条新裤子。
items.py: tā zài yùn dòng shāng diàn mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kù zi
items.en: He bought a pair of new trousers at the sports shop.
items.why: Trousers are long and bendy: 条. 件 is for tops, and 双 is for shoes and other things that come as two separate items.

items.q: 他每天早上喝一___牛奶，然后去游泳。
items.zh: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶，然后去游泳。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shàng hē yī bēi niú nǎi rán hòu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: Every morning he drinks a glass of milk and then goes swimming.
items.why: A drink in a cup or glass takes 杯. 双, 套 and 件 count pairs, sets and clothes.

items.zh: 我买了三张电影票。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le sān zhāng diàn yǐng piào
items.en: I bought three cinema tickets.
items.why: Tickets are flat, so the measure is 张, and it sits between the number and the noun.

items.q: 昨晚下了一___大雨，球场上到处都是水，今天的比赛只好推迟。
items.zh: 昨晚下了一场大雨，球场上到处都是水，今天的比赛只好推迟。
items.py: zuó wǎn xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ qiú chǎng shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ jīn tiān de bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo tuī chí
items.en: A heavy rain fell last night and the pitch is under water, so today's match has to be put off.
items.why: A fall of rain that runs its course is 一场雨. 顿 is for meals, 首 for songs, 节 for class periods.

items.q: 地铁站旁边有___银行，取钱很方便。
items.zh: 地铁站旁边有三家银行，取钱很方便。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn páng biān yǒu sān jiā yín háng qǔ qián hěn fāng biàn
items.en: There are three banks next to the subway station, so it is easy to withdraw money.
items.why: Number first, then the measure, then the noun: 三家银行. 三银行 has no measure and 家三 reverses the order.

items.q: 我在书店买了一___介绍游泳的书。
items.zh: 我在书店买了一本介绍游泳的书。
items.py: wǒ zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn jiè shào yóu yǒng de shū
items.en: I bought a book about swimming at the bookshop.
items.why: Bound books take 本. 张 is for flat sheets and 条 for long things.

items.q: 下雨了，我没带伞，你能借我一___吗？
items.zh: 下雨了，我没带伞，你能借我一把吗？
items.py: xià yǔ le wǒ méi dài sǎn nǐ néng jiè wǒ yī bǎ ma
items.en: It's raining and I did not bring an umbrella. Could you lend me one?
items.why: An umbrella has a handle you hold, so 把. 支 is for pens, 条 for long bendy things, 件 for clothes.

items.q: 你买的这___自行车多少钱？
items.zh: 你买的这辆自行车多少钱？
items.py: nǐ mǎi de zhè liàng zì xíng chē duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much was this bike you bought?
items.why: Bicycles have wheels, so 辆. 这些 would mean 'these bikes', but the cue speaks of one.

items.q: 你的水杯里还有一点儿___水吗？
items.zh: 你的水杯里还有一点儿水吗？
items.py: nǐ de shuǐ bēi lǐ hái yǒu yī diǎn r shuǐ ma
items.en: Is there still a little water in your cup?
items.why: 一点儿 goes straight onto the noun: 一点儿水. Adding 杯 or 个 after it is wrong.

items.q: 这___运动鞋适合爬山，那种适合跑步。
items.zh: 这种运动鞋适合爬山，那种适合跑步。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié shì hé pá shān nà zhǒng shì hé pǎo bù
items.en: This kind of trainer is good for hiking, and that kind is good for running.
items.why: 'This kind of' is 这种. 首, 顿 and 场 count songs, meals and events, and the contrast with 那种 shows kinds.

items.s: 我想买一个杯子送给教练。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè bēi zi sòng gěi jiào liàn
items.zh: 我想买一个杯子送给教练。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè bēi zi sòng gěi jiào liàn
items.en: I want to buy a mug to give to the coach.
items.why: Here the cup itself is the thing being counted, so it is a noun that takes 个.

items.q: 我给在上海的朋友写了一___信，告诉他我参加了城市马拉松。
items.zh: 我给在上海的朋友写了一封信，告诉他我参加了城市马拉松。
items.py: wǒ gěi zài shàng hǎi de péng yǒu xiě le yī fēng xìn gào sù tā wǒ cān jiā le chéng shì mǎ lā sōng
items.en: I wrote a letter to my friend in Shanghai to tell him I had taken part in the city marathon.
items.why: Letters take 封. 张 is for flat sheets such as a postcard, and 本 is for bound volumes.

items.q: 他买了一___运动服，上衣和裤子都是蓝色的。
items.zh: 他买了一套运动服，上衣和裤子都是蓝色的。
items.py: tā mǎi le yī tào yùn dòng fú shàng yī hé kù zi dōu shì lán sè de
items.en: He bought a tracksuit, with both the top and the trousers in blue.
items.why: A top and trousers sold together form a set, so 套. 件 and 条 would count only the top or only the trousers.

items.q: 电影院在商场的五___，坐电梯上去就是。
items.zh: 电影院在商场的五层，坐电梯上去就是。
items.py: diàn yǐng yuàn zài shāng chǎng de wǔ céng zuò diàn tī shàng qù jiù shì
items.en: The cinema is on the fifth floor of the mall; just take the lift up.
items.why: A floor of a building is 层. 家 and 间 count businesses and rooms, and 座 counts whole buildings.
